:3 rin po che'i bye brag gi 'byung khungs skor nang pa'i grang 'cho mdochen pami rdo rje/ 111nya4 khra mar 'god thang skor khra deb 'go dasan kun bzang bstan rgyas/ 117medzi rtsis spyod lam ston las rim kun bzang bstan rgyas/ 14nya16 'grems ston khang la ca chas bzhag dgos pa'i khungs tsho mi nyag sprul sku/ 1743 17 ca rnying tsa khrims zin bris 153 718 khra mar 'khod pa'i ca chas srung skyob sgor grwa tshang bdag spyong 'go dpon lhag pa tshe ring / ༄ 16nyanya9 gsung bshad gnang mi'i mtshan tho 168'a bca' mar gtogag mi'i ming gsal 168'a1 tshig 'grel 173

nang da lhan khragaram̐/ —5 khri mtho/rnyiltar r+shanasang ba sa sa nga tshig pha nyana' yig ang sdon brdzod gan phro phasha zla ratshes 27la/da la ldan ༷gra/ ༷'i rgyal byib zi 'a/da rdzu kha~X dang dgon ༷'i ni ma rigatan 'bas /za rgyu py-i bsdu slangab spyang 'de sral 'an lhan lag gaX ga 'dun 'thab pa zhal ༷dzams kya dmags yul tshu tsa ༷ 'phral phyag gnyas khu 'chib 'bras 'thab dgas pa rnams gsham gsal ltar yon/dang pa zuX/lhaX/ phan /sa/ she sashe she she sheg / khang dgan sda khra ma bzhangs dgas pa' skar las ga bsdur slab bying ga byu rgyu/la sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang mchod chas mchod rdzas kyi rim pa'i skor slob spyong byargyu/ga gasnang rab ༷pe char khungs tshigs don gnad ji bzhin 'grel ba dang goms 'ag tshud phyar/ nga 'grag kyi lha lang dgan 3 khra ma sducar zhibs sa gzhung gi cha'ardzogam 'i miba'i pa'i ༵/ zlo ༷dī / rjo|/ la 995 nang 'khad khra ma mthug bsdu grub pa dmags

garnya pa de rje glu phan thabs/da gzhung grwa tshang chen mo dang phyogs kyi rab sde lag las 'dems bsgos gnang ba'i dge slong rnams dang rjes su rang re'i rgyal lab nang gi mi rigs zhes khra ma bzhengs rgyu'i go bsdur slob spyong bslab ston byu rgyu/ la lha lang dgon sde'i khra ma bris dgos pa dang rtsis spyod zhib dpyod kyi rigs rang so'i sa gnas rdzong lag gi grwa tshang rab sde sku tshab dang rgod 'og so so'i rgod spyo dmang a pa bcas la 'gan khur spyod de 'ong rnams ngo 'dzoms kyis bya dgos pa'i gnad don ltar mthar 'khyol mgo 'drongs grub pa'i dmigs yul/ga 'grag gi rten gsum ca rnying dang ca chas gzhan yang rgyu ci zhig las chib pa yin nam gyin rlabs yod pa'i ra khungs kyi dgye ba dpyad de spyad dngos rnams ma nor bar lag len 'thab shes pa'i ched/ nga sngon gyon rgyal ba gong ma rnams dang bla slob 'gyor ldan pha mes rnams kyis bsgrubs pa'i rten dang ca chas 'gangs can sogs ma 'ongs ngu brgyud mi rabs mang po'i —bar phyag mchod bsod nams kyi zhing du 'gyur ba med pa rgyal lab kyi gces nor lta ngu bdag nyar nan zab dgos pa'i bskal ma spri na skul/ste 2

'a gon tshan gnyis pa/de yang rang re 'grag rgyal khab nang sku rten dang gsung rten ca rnying mnangs can dang 'gangs can tshu ngo spyod nyams pa med par bdag 'dzin bya dgos pa de 'go rim shes dgos pa gal che ba'i gnad khungs yin de las rten gsum spyad dngos 'di bzum tshu 'grag rgyal khab kyi sngar srol lam thugs bzang po'i ca chas yin par brten nga bcas ra'i lha lang dgon sde'i gtsang lang nang 'gangs can byin rlabs yod pa'i ca rnying dang dpe cha mang rabs bsdams te yod rung la khu bdag med lta ngu phar stor tshur stor 'bad bzhag ste yod pa dang la thu mtshad khri khar sprungs te bzhag yod pa las ca rnying skor dngos 'dzin 'bad shes mi bstan dgra dam nyams tshu gi 'a thu 'bag ste rlag stor shor ba'i nyen lag yang sgom 'dug ca rnying dang ca chas yod mi 'di tshu la thu sngon ma las yib pa'i ca rnying 'gangs can yin pa ma tshad byin rlabs chags te yod pa'i ca chas yin pas/ ri gon tshan gamakha pa/deng sang dus kyi 'pho 'gyur dang bstun pa'i mi'i bsam 'char ma 'du ba sna tshogs shar ba las nga bcas ra'i sngon gyon bla ma dam pa rnams dang 'gyor ldan pha mes kyis bsgrubs bzhag yod pa'i ca chas tshu bdag 'dzin sngar las lhag pa sha rjen la me stag reg pa lta gya byas te pha brgyud thu brgyud mi rabs le shā'i bar du rtsis sprod de mi nyams par bdag 'dzin byu dgos pa'i gnang thungs yin pa las nga bcas ra'i rgyal lab nang bsam 'char bzang po'i go las mi tshe gcig gi 3

ring bdag 'dzin 'bad dgo pa'i re ba dang gces spus sgom 'bad dgopa yod pa bzhin da res slob spyong 'di 'go dang pa yin/ de rang 'bad rung de tshu mi dmang gi re ba dang bsam 'char ltar ca chas rnying pa mnangs can tshu bdag 'dzin lhang sgring 'bad shes pa'i ched du yin/don tshan bzhi pa/ rislob spyong 'bad ba'i skabs nga bcas ra'i rgyal khab nang khu sngon gyon rgyal ba gong ma dang pha ma tshu gi mdzad bzhag pa'i shul bzhag rnams ngo sprod 'bad ni gi slob spyong byu rgyu yin/ da res deng sang bsgrubs dang sgrub bzhin yod pa'i sku thang dang mthong sol mchod rdzas la sogs pa ca chas mang rabs cig mos rten du bzhengs te rab gnas mang po gnang ba las byin brlabs chags pa mnangs can k+ṣi gral du tshud de yod pa yin/ de 'badawa las brten 'grag rgyal khab nang gi mnangs can dang 'gangs can gyi ca chas 'di tshu ngo sprod legs shom 'bad tshugs ni don lu khu ma nang btsugs te bdag 'dzin 'bred dgopa 'di gal ga ni ba che /don tshan lnga pa/de ltar nga bcas ra'i rgyal khab nang dbyin lo 1985lo khu srol 'dzin lhan lag zer btsugs dgos pa gong gsal gyi gnad don 'di thu brten te yin pa ma tshad mi dbang mnga' bdag rin po che sku nyid kyi thugs bskyed smon lam dang brtse ba rgya che sa las gnang ste nga bcas ra'i rgyal khab nang gi sku rten gsung rten dang mnangs can 'gangs can gyi ca chas tshu ge ra snying dngas ma'i dkyil las bdag 4

'dzin legs shom 'thab dgos pa 'di nga bcas ra'i lam lugs bzang po'i srol 'gyun shul chags nyams pa med par mtha' spyong 'bad ni'i don du gong gsal rten dang spyad dngos de rnams tho bkod de bdag 'dzin 'bad dgom 'bad bka' rgya yang las yang du gnang ste yod/nga bcas ra'i spyi nor dam pa mi dbang mnga' bdag rin yo che 'i thugs kyi brtse ba dang dgongs bzhed bla na med pa'i sog las bka' rgya gnang yod mi 'di nga bcas ra ge ra gi re re bzhin du 'bad 'gan khur 'bag shes pa cin rten gsum ca rnying sogs 'gangs can dang mnangs can rnams nga bcas ra'i rgyal khab nang yod mi 'di tshu sngar las lhag ste bdag 'dzin gang dug 'bad tshugs pa'i re ba sgom yod/bkris bde legs/ring po/nasprepa slobarngapa /

ca sa gsung bshad/sngon gyon sangs rgyas stong gis ma thul ba'i/ / snyo mon la bzhi nags mo'i rdzongs gyi 'gror/ / lugs gnyis khrims kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba po/ / mthu chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ / ces mchod brdzod kyi me tog sngon du 'thor nas/ gang zhig zhu ba byu bar ni rang re sman rdzongs tshos ldan gyi rgyal khab 'di nang dang po bdag cag gi lton pa shākya thub pa de nyid sngon tshe lo brgya pa'i dus su 'jig rten du gyon/ rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas nas rdzu 'phrul chen yo'i sku dngos gyi 'dzam gling spyi dang rang re'i rdzongs 'dir zhabs bca gas pa'i dbang gis/ slar nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo sde gsungs pa'i skabs/ ston pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i gnas gsum las 'od zer bkyes nas/ byung phyogs kyi ri klung nags khrod yul rdzongs 'di rnams la yog nas dam pa'i chos 'byung ba'i gnas su byin gyi brlabs/ ma 'ongs pa na yul rdzongs de la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / dge 'dun sde dang / gtsug lag khang sogs 'byung bar lung bstan/de dag gi mchod pa'ang nga nyid kyis bzhes so zhes gsungs pa'ang gtso rgo mtha' 'ob mon gyi yul 'di yin no/ rgyal ba'i mdzad brgya'i skye rabs las/ sngon bdag cag gi ston pa de nyid/ thams cad sgrol dang / gtsug na nor gya/ dri med kun ldan sogs su skye ba bzhes dus/ rgyal srid spangs nas byang chub kyi spyod pa spyad pa'i tshe/ dgas gyur tshal nas byung du dpag tshad brgya 'das pa'i nags rdzongs su ting nge 'dzin gyi zas la brten te dka' thub dgyes pa'i tshul gyi gnas so zhes gsungs pa ste/ de dus su kha che dang bal yul bod rnams su mcho ma bri bas nags rdzongs gang yang med/ de ni 11

lto mon gyi sa cha yin la gor ma chag / sngon 'dzom ngu gling pa'i tshe lo bzhi khri tsam nas mi yi 'gro ba byung bas kha khra mon pa zhes pa'i ming thogs pa sogs mon yul chags pa yin no/ sngon sangs rgyas shākya thub pa gyon skabs nas chos ldan gyi yul du bsgyur ba dang / bar du sangs rgyas gnyis pa o rgyan thams cad mkhyen pas spyir 'dzam gling gi sa cha rta mig tsam yang ma lus par zhabs kyi bcags shing pyin gyi brlab pa dang /khyad par rang re'i sman rdzongs 'di ni lhag par du chos tshig gi yul du bzung ste/nyid rang gi gsung las/ nga yi rjes 'jug chos byed gang zag rnams: snyo rong sbas pa'i yul du bros shig dang ཿ zhes chos ldan gyi yul du lung bstan gsung ste gangs brag ri mcho thams cad mas nor zab gter gyi bkang ste sbas yul du byin gyis brlab/ tha mar thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa gyon nas dpal ldan 'byug pa'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i lung bstan yang gsungs so/ rang re sman rdzongs yongs kyi spyabs mgon mthu chen ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi o rgyan thams cad mkhyen pa'i thung bstan dang dam can chos spyongs rnams kyis bskul ma zhus pa las 'aspo don dus la bab ste chibs la ltor bsgyur ba nas bzung lto khrims med la khrims dang rdza khung med la thung 'dogs te chos srid gyi snang ba dar phab ste lto mon gyi yul dman pa ni chos ldan gyi yul bzang mor 'dzam gling kun gyi nang na dpal lda na 'grag pa'i chos ldan gyi rgyal khab phrul du gyur pa 'di byung bas/ dam pa'i chos kyi dngu brnyes nas 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i ji srid 'khor ba ma stong bar du chogs bsags sgrib spyongs dang phyag mchod kyi yul kyibs gnas dam pa sangs rgyas dang byung chub sems dpa' yid dam brgyud sde bzhi sogs dam can chos spyongs rgya mcho yul lha bzhi bdag gi 12

sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa'i srol zur tsam zhu na/ dang po / sku thang bri ba'i srol thogs mar mdzad brgya dpag bsam 'khri shing du/ sangs rgyas shākya grub pas nyid rang gi sku gzugs kyi tshad dang bzhugs stangs sogs ri mo legs por bris te ngu mo mu tig 'khri shing la phyag mchod kyi rten du gnang bas/ de nas bzung ste sku thang bri ba'i srol da lta'i bar ma nyams par yod pa dang / kha mchod rten bzhengs pa'i srol thogs mar byams par khung bstan pa'i rtogs brdzod las brgya byin gyis/ bi sha /mi bzo sor bskos nas rin yo che mang yor bsdus nas mchod rten bzhengs nas mang pos bkur ba la rten skal du byin/ mthar klu yul du bzhugs pa de/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas gang gā sgrul gyi zam pa phebs dus su sangs rgyas kyi klu las bzhes te dge slong rnams la bstan pa las dper blangs te bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad sogs bzhengs par grags so/ u spri ya na'i rtogs brdzod skabs rgyal yo gzugs can snying po'i bco ma ldan 'das kyi drung du phyin/ sku 'du zhus pa'i lo rgyus nus te/sku la tshad byas pa gzhal bar ma nus tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi bris gzhi la 'od 'char du bcug pa dang / rgya mtsho la sku'i ri mo 'char du bcug nas bris pas legs yor bris byung bas/ der nas dper blangs te sku dang thang ka bzhengs pa'i dpe thog mar byung /de yang sangs rgyas kyi sku 'du chu rgya ma zhes grags pa byung / ga rang re bka' brgyud gong ma mar pa dang mi la'i skabs mar pas mi la la kye rdor gyi dbang bskur dus kye rdor gyi lha chogs dang dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang sogs mngon sum du sprul ste gnang ba mjal bas de nas dpe brang ba dang / 'gro mgon gtsang pas rten 'grel gyi don sgom dus sangs rgyas rnam gzigs sogs yid dam rgyud sde bzhi'i 13

lha chogs mang po'i zhal gzigs te dpe blang ba dang / kun mkhyen pad dkar zhabs kyis kyang ngo mtshar rtags brgyad kyi gzigs snang sogs sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam mkha' 'khro rlos skyongs rnams kyi zhal gzigs sogs las dpe blang ba dang / nga lhag par rang re sman rdzongs yongs kyi gtsug nor dam pa mthu chen chos kyi rgyal pos nyid rang gi yab me gong ma rnams kyi mdzad shul la dpe blang ba dang /lhag par sku nyid rang thugs dam la bzhugs dus sangs rgyas byung sems brgyud sde sogs khyo zhal yang yang gzigs pa ma zad chos spyongs kyi gsol la gnang dus dgongs pa gtad tsam la'ang ye shes mgon yo sogs chos skyongs rnams kyi mi dang mi bzhin du gzigs pa la dpe blang ste bzhengs pa yin no/ / / / sku rten sogs bzhengs rgyu'i rgyu dngos kyang gser dngul zangs lcags sogs rin chen bzhi dang / lha klu mi gsum gyi rin po che mang po bsdus pa la dzigi zhes 'dzam gling nang rin thang med pa dang/ rin chen gsum gyi nang na rin thang che ba'i chu zangs/ shar li ma zhes li dkar dang li dmar sogs dang pye ma a 'grangs dang rdo nag a brgya ma rdo nag ril gya sogs klu byin dang tsan dan dkar dmar sogs shing gi rigs dang / bse rwa ba so sogs rus tog gi rigs dang / sman 'jim sogs gnas sa dang sangs rgyas byung sems bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyi pyin gyis brlabs pa rnams las bzhengs par grags so/sangs rgyas rdo rje/mtshan nyid slob dpon/14

'grag rgyal yongs shes nyon gas bsgrags rnams la sku rten 'gyur dod sku brnyan da nga 'jim bas malas pa ji ltar rgyung ba' tshul mdor bsdus ཿ trī ba la/dang po spyir 'jig rten gyi lams 'dir bdag cag gi ston pa bkrin can mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po'i zhal spyin mthong grol chen mo 'thur du ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul ni/ sngon sangs rgyas brtsom ldan 'das kyi ma 'ongs pa na bdag nyid ma mthong ba'i skye bo dag gi tshogs gsog pa dang / dge 'dun 'dus pa'i rten dang / bdud dang mu stegs zil gyis gnon pa dang / bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'i phyir sku tshab bzhengs shig ces 'phags pa 'jam dpal la bka' gnang ba ltar/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis rin po che sna lnga bcu tsa gcig sgungs te bzo bo bi shwa garma la sangs rgyas kyi sku tshad gsum bzhengs su bcug pas dgung lo brgyad pa dang bcu gnyis pa'i tshad can rim bzhin du pang du 'tsho ba'i ma ma dang /rgyan 'dogs pa'i ma ma las len te bzhengs par grags pa dang / bzhed srol mi 'du ba gzhan yang / khyim bdag dad spyin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi dge 'dun rnams rang gi khyim du gdugs tshod la spyan dungs pa'i tshe na ston pa ma gyon tshe gral gyi thog ma mi brjid par mthong nas khyim bdag mgon med zas spyin gyis ston pa'i 'du sku bgyid du chog par gsol bas gnang ste rin yo che'i rigs sna tshogs kyi rgyu las byas pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs par grags pa dang / yang ston pa lha gnas su yum la chos ston par gshegs pa'i shul na gsal ldan gyi rgyal glon rnams kyis dad rten sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan bzhengs su 'dod pa'i tshe mo'u gal gyi grus rdzu 'phrul la brten nas bzo bo dang lhan cig lha gnas su phyin te 15

sangs rgyas kyi sku'i dbyibs ji lta ba sgor nges par byas nas grong khyer gsal ldan du slar log ste rgyu tsan dan las tshib pa'i ston pa'i snang ba rnyan phyag g.yas kyibs spyin dang g.yon pa mtshog spyin can bzhengs stabs su bzhugs pa bzhengs par grags pa dang / lha dbang brgya srin gyis sprul pa'i bzo nyo bi sha gam la bsgos nas rgyu lha dang mi'i nor ngu du ma las chib pa'i ston pa dgung lo brgyad pa'i tshad can rdzo bo mi baspyod rdo rje/ bcu gnyis pa'i tshad can po so shākya mu ne/ nyer lnga'i sku tshad can rnams bzhengs su bcug cing / rim bzhin dming lo nyer lnga'i tshad can lha'i dbang po brgya gyin gyis sum cu tsa gsum du spyan springs pa dang brgyad pa'i tshad can bal yul du gdan dungs pa dang / bcu gnyis pa'i tshad can rgya nag tu gdan springs pa las phyis chos rgyal srong btsan gyi dus su rgya bal gyi rgyal po'i sras mo gnyis btsun mor bsus pa'i skyel rdzong du bod kyi bsod nams kyi zhing sar gyon pa 'di gnyis ston pa dngos kyi zhal gyi 'od zer spro bsdus byin gyis brlabs pa las sku dngos dang byin rlabs mtshungs par grags/ gzhan yang ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su ma ga lha'i bram ze mo dza sa la thu sbun gsum yod pa las tha chung gis lha'i sprul pa'i bzo rgo la brten nas bzhengs par grags pa ston paḍi dming lo so lnga'i tshad can dngu'i gtsug tor bstar mngon pa la sogs mtshan dpe'i khyad par brgyad tsam ma gtogs ston pa ci 'du bar yod pa'i rten mtshog ma hā nyo dz+nya dang / klu sgrub gyi dus klu'i bzo bos 'jim pa las bcos pa'i sku rten rnams khyad par 'phags pa mang du byung zhing / de bzhin lha klu gnod spyin la sogs mi'i brdzu la zhugs pa'i sprul pa'i bzo bo mang du byung ba rnams gyi dpe rgyun las rim bzhin rgya stod kun tu dar ba yin no/16

gnyis pa rang re'i sman rdzongs 'grag gi rgyal lab 'di nang 'thur sku sog mar ji ltar byung ba'i tshul la gong gi bod rgyal srong btsan gyis mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs skabs ston pa dming lo bcu gnyis pa'i tshad can rdzo so shākya mu ne+e la dpe blangs te bzhengs pa spa kro spyor chu dang sum thang byams pa lha khang du bzhugs pa rnam gnyis te byin rlabs lha sa'i rdzo go rnam gnyis dang khyad par med do/ de ltas gzhan yang gyis sum thang rtse lung dang dge ldan a nu lha lang gi rten rnam snang dang 'khor du rgyal ba rigs lnga sogs bzhengs par grags shing de dag la dpe byas te rgyu rin po che dang sa rdo chu shing sogs las sprul pa'i bzo bo rnams kyis 'gyar du dod pa dang thugs su blugs pa dang spros su brko ba la sogs pa byung ba 'du'o/gsum pa rdzongs 'dir sman 'jim malas pa'i bzo rgo ji ltar byung tshul la/spyir sngar 'jim bzo mkhas pa yongs su grags pa dang ma grags pa brdzod gyis mi langs pa zhig gyon yod nges la/ de dag thams cad rang cag so so'i skye sos dpags par mi nus shing / phyogs mtshon tsam du ni rdzongs 'di'i bstan pa'i bdag yo zhabs grang ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis dpal ldan dbyar rnga'i gdan sa gtso rgo sbungs thang bde ba chen po'i po brang gis gtsos gdan sa lag dang rdzong gzhis lha khang dgon sde rnams phyag btab cing / de dag rnams su sku rten bzhengs rgyur rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i sprul pa sprul sku rdzing zhes grags pa'i 'jim bzo mkhas pa nyid ched du gdan 'dren zhus te rdzong gzhis lha khang dgon lag rnams su sman 'jim gyi kri brnyan bzhengs 'dug pa de nyid thog ma yin 'dug / de nas sprul sku rdzing gi slob ma sprul sku bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan dge slong ngag dbang shes rab/ sprul sku ngag dbang phran tshogs sogs la 17

rim par brgyud de spa kro gnas phyag sprul sku rim gyon gyis slob ma rnams nas dar 'dugade'ang gnas thug gi slob ma mkhas pa slob dpon phyar rgyan dang / dngos tshib sogs las dngos yib kyi slob ma spa spro ba slob dam chos dang / dpal ldan sogs kyis rang re'i min rdzongs 'grag gi rgyal khab shar nub gnyis gyi rdzong gzhis lha khang dgon sde rnams su sku brnyan sngar yod nyams pa zhig gso dang gsar du bzhengs pa rnan sa kun gyi mthun snang du tshib pa de dag lags pas de lugs dang / slob dam chos dang dpal ldan gnyis kyi sku tshe'i bar tsam nas 7rang re'i min rdzongs 'di'i spyi nor chen po 'grug rgyal gsum pa 'ami rje 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug mchog gi 'a'ajim bzo sogs bzo rigs rnams kyang sngar yod nyams pa sor chud dang / sngar med gsar du slob spyong tshugs rgyu'i thugs bskyed bla na med pa'i nyer len la brten bkris sgang cha 'og sbris dung om ltong dang bkris rin chen rdo rje ram 'byar nas phran phyag rdor dang gami tshe ring rdo rje sogs mi grangs bco lnga tsam bsdus nas gong gi slob dpon dpal ldan nyid phran tsho'i slob dpon du gnang bas slob dpon des kyang phran tshor brtse bas legs par slob gnang zhing / phran slob phrug rnams nas kyang thig tshad rnam 'gyur sogs gang la'ang lhan po'i rlos legs par bslab pa mthil phyin par bgyid khul lags pa ma zad grwa tshang gzhung gi dkyil 'khor slob dpon bya mdangs dang mkhas mcherag dge bshes tshe dbang rnam gnyis kyi spyan sngar rgyugs kyang phrul tshib pa lags/bzhi pa phran chos de ltar slob spyong mthar phyin nas 'jim bzo'i zhabs tog ji ltar zhus pa'i tshul la/ 7mi rje 'grag rgyal gsum pa'i dgongs rdzogs su thim thug bkris chos rdzong nang ston pa thog tshad gnyis ma gtso 'khor gsum dang gzhan yang rdor 18

sems mi 'khrugs pa thog tshad ma rnams 7rje khri zur bstan 'dzin don tshib pa'i sde'i zhal bkod bzhin slob dam chos kyis dngu gtsos phran gong gsal ba rnams kyis bzhengs pa ma zad de nas rim par zil gnon rnam rgyal gling gi dgongs rdzogs mchod rten du'ang bka' dgongs phyar gsum gyi sku brnyan yongs rdzogs 7spyabs rje bdud 'joms 'gro 'dul gling pa yab sras kyi zhal bkod ltar phran rnams kyis dad yis spyo gsum gyi sgo nas bzhengs pa dang pha rdzo sding du'ang yi ru gtso 'khor thog tshad gnyis ma sum thang sku rjes rdo rje brtsegs pa bka' dgongs tshar gsum rgya gar 'phags yul rdo rje gdan du ston pa gtso 'khor gsum dang yi ru gtso 'khor gsum/ spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum cing logs rnams su ston pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis 'grur dod rnams dang / bkris sgang bkang thung zangs mdog dpal rir 'og lang du gtso so snang srid zil gnon gyis gtsos pa'i mtha' skor du bsam lhun lha bcu gsum bar khang thugs chen sdug bsngal rang sol gtso 'khor steng khang du 'od dpag med gtso 'khor bcas/ 'grag lto mtshams su'ang pho gling zangs mdog dpal rir 'og khang du yi ru gtso 'khor snang srid zil gnon la mtha' skor mtshan brgyad dang logs bris bsam lhun lha bcu gsum rnams 'thur ma bar khang du thugs chen phyag stong spyan stong steng khang du 'od dpag med gtso 'khor bcas/ bsam rdzongs zangs mdog dpal rir yang chos longs sprul gsum bcas pa bzhengs shing da lta'ang gzhung gi zhabs zhus 'ongs su 'jim bzo slob spyong ba yod dang yod bzhin pa ma zad phran phyag rdor rang ngos nas kyang gzhung gi zhabs zhus ci nus thog 'jim bzo grags bzo'i bzo grwa gzhung gi bka' dang bstun te tshugs yod pa'i nang du'ang slob drug 'ga' shas la slob spyong sprad dang sprod bzhin pa yin no/ 19

lnga pa glu rten de rnams la dbye ba mdor bsdus dang mtha' bsgoms zur tsam zhig zhu na mdo ltar dus gsum sangs rgyas sangs rgyas rab bdun sman bla bde ga shegs mched brgyad bde gshegs so lnga bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong tsa byang sems nye sras brgyad 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug rnam she dang / sngagang ltar na/ kri gsum las/chos sku'i sku gsum/ longs sku'i sku gsum/ sprul sku'i sku gsum dang/ mo brgyud ltar sku gsum/ zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya/ dgongs 'dus lha dmi / bka' brgyad gtso dmi sogs mang zhing /de'ang chos sku'i chos sku kun tu bzang po/ chos sku'i longs sku rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas/ chos sku'i sprul sku rigs gsum mgon po'o/ / longs sku'i tshos sku rdo rje 'chang chen/ long sa sku'i longs kri rdo rje sems dpa'/ longs sku'i sprul glu dga' rab rdo rje'o/ sprul sku'i chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ sprul sku'i longs sku thugs rje chen po/sprul sku'i sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas so/ chos sku'i longs sku rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas ni/ rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje sems dpa' rin chen 'byung gnas snang ba mtha' yas don yon tshib pa lnga / rnam par chos sku'i sprul sku rigs gsum mgon po ni 'jam dpal dbyangs spyan ras gzigs phyag na rdo rje'o/ yang sku gsum gyi sku gsum mi 'du ba zhig ni/chos sku'i chos sku kun tu bzang po/ chos sku'i longs kri rdo rje 'chang chen chos sku'i sprul sku rdo rje sems dpa'o/ longs sku'i chos sku rnam snang gangs chen longs sku'i longs sku rigs lnga sangs rgyas longs sku'i sprul sku phyag na rdo rje'o/ sprul sku'i chos sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku'i longs kri rigs gsum mgon po/ spul sku'i spul sku thub pa chen po'o/mo brgyud ltar kri gsum ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang mo/ b.longs sku re rje phab/ mo/ spul kri rje ༷ ba 20

btsun skyol ma'o/ rtsa gsum zhi ba bla ma yi ru dug po rdo rje glo lod/ yi dam zhi ba spyan ras gzigs dug po phyar pa mkha' 'gro zhi ba ye shes mtsho rgyal dug po seng gdong ma gzhan yang bla ma rig 'dus dang yi ru dug po yi dam 'jam dkar phag mo mkha' spyod sogs lhag pa'i lha mang po yod/sngags gsar ma ltar bde mtshog 'gring po lha bcu gsum ma dang bde mtshog dril gya lha lnga ma bde mtshog grag cu ma dus 'khor gsang 'dus kye rdor 'jigs byed la sogs pa dang dpal mgon bdun cu tsa lnga sogs tsa gsum dam can rgya mcho rnams kyi mtshanasmos kyis mi langs pa ba zhugs shing sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lhogs rnams ni lta ci smos 'on kyang so so'i sgrub thabs phrin las kyi byang thu mngon rtogs rnams la gzigs pas khyab pa nyid 'dir gyon pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams mkhyen rgya los kyang che zhu rgyu dang / phran pas ston pa dang yi ru sogs sngar mjal myong ba'i sku brnyan re zung rnams kyang gong du zhus pa ltar bla ma rnams kyi zhal bkod la brten nas bzhengs pa las lhag pa'i lha rab 'byams gang la'ang thog pa med par bzhengs thub pa dang brda spyod byed nus pa ma yin na'ang da res gzhung gi las 'gan par song stabs gzhung gi bka' nan ma ldog pa'i sa khungs tsam du gang dun thar thor re zhus pa lags na 'gal 'khrul nor ba'i skyon rnams 'dir phebs pa gyogs dman yongs la bzod par gsol nas nyes 'gog legs 'phel gyi bka' slob kyang gnang rogs zhes zhu ba dang chabs cig bka' drin che zhes dang bkris bde legs zhu gi yod/ phyag rdor cho ring /'jim bzo slob dpon/ 21

gsung rten dpe cha dang par sheng gi rgyung sgrungs gsal bshad/༄7/ de la da res yis phran pa'i gsung rten gyi skor nas zhu rgyu la/ dang po gsung rten gyi phyi mo yi ge'i skor nas zhu rgyu dang / gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka'i skor nas zhu rgyu dang / gsum pa paṇa ḍi ta'i dgongs 'grel bstan bcos kyi skor nas zhu rgyu dang / bzhi pa par shing gi skor nas zhu rgyu dang / lnga pa de rnams gang yang rin thang bral ba'i rin po che las rtsa chen po yin tshul zhu rgyu las/ dang po gsung rten phyi mo'am rtsa ba yi ge la 'dzam gling rgyal khab so so la yi ge re yod pa thams cad las nga rang tsho'i yi ge dngu can 'di ni yi ge thams cad kyi nang nas rtsa che shos shig yin la/ tsa che shos yin pa'i rgyu mtshan dngu can yi ge 'di ni rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rab gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs 'jam dpal dbyangs mi'i gzugs su gyon pa thu mi sam glo ṭa nyid gyis gzhi latsi lha'i yi ge la brten nas rnam pa skyes ngu'i gzugs gnas pa tsa/ g.yo ba rlung / bkod pa byung chub kyi sems/ de nyid man ngag gis gnad du bsnun na kri gsum rang mal nas 'chib tu yod pa'i tsa gnas dang mthun par mdzad pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yi ge gzhan kun la dngu can yi ge 'di nyid rtsa che shos yin par gsungs/ de lta thu'i yi ge 'bri ba po rang nyid yum chen mo shes rab nu pha rol tu phyin ma'i skur gsal ba'am yum chen mo'i skur mos te/ smyu gu'i rtse ral gri rked pa phyag na rdo rje rtsa ba spyan ras gzigs rigs gsurmi mgon

por mos pa nas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par byu/ de'i ched du sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad mkhan sangs rgyas gyi gsung yi ge'i gzugs su sprul pa bkye bar bya'o snyam pa'i kun slong bzang yo byung chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed de/ shog ngu sogs bri zhig gang yin pa'i ngos la yig 'gra gcig bris sprul pa gcig bkyes/ gnyis bris sprul pa'i gnyis bkyes pa sogs yig 'byu re re bzhin du sprul pa re bkyes pa de la/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dag / kun tu thogs med gzigs pa ldan/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de ltar bris pa'i yi ge la ye shes pa yang dus mnyam du zhugs pa'i sprul pa grangs med pa mthong thos dun reg gis sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin pas na/ mthong thos sprin reg gi sems can gyi rgyud la thar pa'i sa nyon thebs te 'brel tshad don ldan 'khor ba mtha' can du bkod par gyur pa'i gsung rten yi ge ral ma tsam yang me la bsregs pa sogs mi rung zhing tha na yi ge (na)tsam la'ang brnyas mi rung gsungs pa'i don de yin gsungs/ gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka'i skor nas zhu rgyu la/ de yang ston pa grub pa'i dbang yos bka' dang yo bden pa bzhi'i 'khor lo dang / bka' bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i 'khor lo dang / bka' mtha' ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i tshos gyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor ba zhal nas gsungs pa dang / rjes su gnang ba dang / byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka'/ gdul byu rnams kyi rgyud la nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen po 23

chos kyi cing po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa brdzod byu rtogs pa'i bstan pa tshul khrims gyi bslab pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ shes rab gyi bslab pa gsum la/ rdzod byed khung gi bstan pa 'dul ba'i sde snod/ mdo sde'i sde snod/ mngon pa'i sde snod gsum gyi 'dul ba khung sde bzhi las ci rigs pa lo tsā ba rnams kyis god du bsgyur pa dang / bka' bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyas pa'i rgyas pa 'thum phrag brgya pa dri za'i rgyal pos gdan springs/ rgyas pa'i 'bring khri phrag brgya pa lha'i da bang yos lha yul du gdan springs/ rgyas pa'i bsdus pa ltong phrag brgya pa klu'i rgyal yos klu yul du gdan springs pa las/ klu'i rgyal pos sras na ba la dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub gdan springs pa gyon te klu'i don s+dza de klu'i rgyal po'i sras na ba sos pa'i gtang rag tu nor thu phrul ba ma bzhes par/ yum sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa bzhes te mi'i yul du gdan springs pa yum sher phyin rgyas pa dang / gzhan yang mdo sde phal chen dang dkon brtsegs nyis khri myang 'das brgyad stong pa sogs dung nges gyi mdo sde mang sa lo tsā ba rnams kyis yi ge dngu can 'di yis bod du bsgyur ba dang / 'bras thu sngags nu theg pa rgyud sde bzhi sod du bsgyur pa 'thor thabs su bzhugs pa rnams/ bcom ldan rig ral gyis dngus pa blo gsal dang / lo tsā ba bsod nams 'od zer/ rgyang ngo byang chub 'thum gsum la bkas bskul te 'bad rtsol chen pos bod dngus gtsang khams gsum nas phyi mo bsdus te dka' tshegs chen pos sde tshan so sor balhags pa sdom po ti brgya lhag tsam bzhugs pa dus rabs bcu bdun pa yan chad la bris pa ma gtogs par du 'khod pa med pa la/ rgyal yo khri srong lde btsan gyi phrin las kyi 24

sprul pa gong sa lnga pa glo bzang rgya mchos shing par brko rgyu 'go btsugs pa sku phreng bdun pa'i skabs mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi snying stobs dang gtong yod kyis gcig las du ma 'char ba'i par zhig bskrun tshib pa las/ bka' 'gyur par ma phyag macesad bsod nams zhing du rang re sman rdzongs 'dir ya nga dar rgyas su byung ba de ni/ nor ngu rin sa che dbang gi rgyal po kun gyi spyod yul du byung ba'i do zla min zhes zhu ba lags/gsum pa paṇa ḍi ta'i dgongs 'grel bstan bcos gyi skor nas zhu rgyu la/ de yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' shin tu zab cing rgya che bas rtogs par dka' pa de nyid/snying rje pad dkar dang 'jam dpal tsa rgyud la sogs pa'i mdo rgyud rnams nas ma 'ongs pa na bka'i dgongs pa rang stobs kyis 'grel bar nus pa'i paṇa ḍi ta rgyan drug mchog gnyis chen po bzhi rmad du byung ba'i slob dpon rnam pa gnyis mkhas pa sgo drug la sogs pa 'byung bar thung bstan pa bzhin 'khrungs pa'i dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis zab mo lta ba'i shing rta'i srol phye/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis rgya chen spyod pa'i shing rta'i srol phye nas ar+ya de wa dang dbyig gnyen la sogs pa'i paṇa ḍi ta mang yos rgya cher spel ba'i bka'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos ngan pa drug dang bral cing bzang sa gsum dang 'chos spyob gyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa/ 'phags pa sa la gnas pa'i byung chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mdzad pa yig 'gra re la ye shes gyi mkha' 'kho ma re gnas par gsungs pas na/ gang sgyur rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig phyor/ / dbang rgyas rnam g.yeng med yid can 25

gyis byas/ / thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa/ / de yang dung srong bka' bzhin spyi gos blang / / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas bka' dang gnyis su med pa rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa yib mtha' smra ba bzhi dang / 'bras gya sngags gyi theg pa rgyud sde bzhi'i dgongs pa legs par 'grel ba'i bstan bcos rnams thugs rjes yas sprul gyi lo tsā ba rnams kyis dka' tshegs chen yos rgod du gdan springs te/ yi ge dngu can gyis legs par bsgyur bar mdzad pa yo ti grangs nyis brgya lhag tsam bzhugs pa de yang dus rabs bcu bdun pa la god kyi sde srid mi dbang bsod nams ltobs rgyas kyi snying stobs dang gtong yod lhag bsam thugs bskyed kyis shing par du baspyin par mdzad pa gtsang snar thang du bzhugs pa las/rang re min rdzongs 'dis mtshon srid pa gsum gyi skye 'gro'i bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing du gdan dungs te bzhugs pa de ni nor thu rin po che dbang gi rgyal yos tshe 'di'i dngul ba sel ba tsam las gzhan mi nus/ gsung rab rin po che 'dis ni tshe 'di phyi bar do gsum dang 'khor ba'i dgral ba ma thus pa bsal te rnam khrol gtan gyi bde ba pyir mi ldog pa'i sa la 'god par mthu ldan gyi rin po che mchog tu gyur pa/ sku gsung thugs gsum las kyang gsung rten gtso che ba yin te/ sku rten dang thugs rten la gsung rten gyi gzungs med na 'jig rten phal pas kyang gzungs med pa'i sku/ gzungs med pa'i mchod rten zhes tsa chen mi brtsi la/ gzungs la ring bsrel rnam bzhi las/ gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po'i sngags rnams dros sku'i ring bsrel zhes gtso che ba yin pa dang / bka' thog hu kri mi 'jog ces gsung rten thog sku gzhag mi rung la/ sku'i thog tu gsung rten gzhag rung 26

bar gsungs/ gnas skabs su gsung rten 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi lku tshab/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi sku tshab/ khro med kyi slob dpon/ rang gis mjal thub na dge sdig spang blang gi bslab byu shes byu bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi yon tan ston mtho ris thar pa rnam mkhyen gyi lam ston mkhan/ dgongs pa gtan nas khrel ni med pa'i slob dngon bzang yo zhes zhu ba lags/bzhi pa shing par gyi skor nas zhu rgyu la/ bka' dang bstan bcos kyi gsung rab dam pa'i chos kyi yi ge rnams dus rabs bcu bdun pa yan chad la shing par brkos pa cung zad re las mi 'dug cing / yi ge shing par du 'khod pa'i dang po 'dul ba nas dge slong rnams kyi rgya'am thi'u ri mo thod skam brko dgos pa gsungs pa bzhin dge slong gi thi'u la ri mo thod skam brkos pa dang / gzhan gyis pad+ma dang rgya gram byu gyi sogs ri mo gzhan lcags dang 'khar ba zangs la thi'u'i ri mo brkos pa'i rigs pas rlung dar dang dar par dpe tshan la 'thor re brkos shing / rgyal ba gong sa lnga pa'i skabs par brko rgyu rlabs chen gyi bya ba bka' 'gyur par brko rgyu 'go btsugs kyang bzhi cha tsam brkos mtshams nas kri gshegs te lus/ de'i 'gro rgyal ba tshangs dbyungs rgya mtsho'i skabs brkos kyang sog yo lha bzang khang gis rgyal ba rgya nag tu gdan springs te lus/ sku phreng bdun pa'i rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i skabs sde srid tha'i rje mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyas kyis dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i nang bris pa dang rko tshe ba'i slob grwa btsugs te bris pa dang rko tshe ba mang po thon pas bka' 'gyur gyi

'gros brkos yib ste/ de nas snying stobs dang gtong phod chen pos bstan 'gyur cha tshang brkos 'dug de rjes khams sde dge ru tshos rgyal sangs rgyas bstan pa dang bstan pa tshe ring gis bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur shing par brkos te dar khyab byung 'dug rang re'i rdzongs 'dir zhabs grang rin po che 'i skabs kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po'i bka' 'thum las nyer ma'o'i rigs shing par brkos 'dug sde srid mi 'gyur brtan pa dang rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyis mdo mangs dang ma ṇi bka' 'gyam pad+ma thang yig sogs mang po brkos 'dug sde srid bco brgyad pa 'jigs med seng ges kun mkhyen pad dkar bka' 'thum cha tshang brkos 'dug pa rnams tshang ma mes 'jig 'dug sde srid nyer gcig pa 'grag rnam rgyal gyis sman gyi rgyud bzhi sgu ka tsan dbyungs gsum zhabs drung rnam thar rje btsun mgyur 'thum pad+ma thang yig sogs mes 'jig pa rnams brkos/ sde srid bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis kun mkhyen bka' 'gyam mes 'jig pa slar brkos 'dug rje shākya rin chen gyis byams chos sde lnga sogs brkos/ rje 'jam dbyungs rgyal mtshan gyis yon tan mtha' ya sa kyi bka' 'bum sogs brkos 'dug bar skabs nas yi ge brko rgyu nyams 'dug pa tu brko rgyu nyams mi 'dug deng sang lams sde dge nas rko tshe ba dge rgan pad+ma nas slob rgyun la shas thon pa las da lta kun mkhyen bka' 'gyam gzhi nas brkos te zhus dag rgyab ngang yod zhu/ lnga pa gsung rten de rnams rin thang bral ba'i rin yo che rnams las rtsa chen yin pa zhu rgyu la/rgya chen srid pa 'di na srid pa'i dngos/ / rin thang brdzod la khrel ba kun grongs kyang / /28

rin chen gsu ma zhes grags pa'i mtshan tsam gyi/ / rin thang brdzod la bsgrun pa ma yin no/ /shes gsungs pa ltar/ nor gya bsam 'phel ma/ dgos 'dod dpung 'joms/ dbang gi rgyal po sogs ji tsam tsa chen yang gsung rten rin yo che 'i cha tsam gyi do zla yang mi na zhing /nor gra de rnams kyis gnas skabs tshe 'di'i dngul phongs kyi sdug bsngal sel ba tsam las tshe phyi mar phan par lta zhog de la zhen cing chags pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyu byed/ gsung rten rin po che ni slob dayon dbyig gnyen gyis gsung rab rin po che zhal ton gnang ba'i sgra phyag ron gyis tho sa pas phyag ron shi nas mi lus thob slob mar gyur te slob dpon blo gos brtan pa thar pa'i go 'phang thob pa thos sal yin pa de bzhin/ gsung rten rin po che ni mig gis mthong na mthong khrol/ lce yis myong na myong grol/ reg na reg rgol 'khor ba nas thar pa'i lam mthong ba'i glo sas kyi mig ster ba'i mthu dang 'brel tshad don ldan gyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa bzhin nor thu de rnams la med pas/gsung rten rin po che ni rang re rgyal khab kyi nor gyi snying po'i yang snying bcud kyi yang bcud gces spus su 'dzin dgos pa yin zhes zhu ba lags/ 29

jugs rten dang de sgru nga dang dgos pa/ ri.oṃ bde legs su gyur cig / gang zhig bsten pas 'as mang khams kyi zhing / / bsod nams ye shes tshogs kyi son thebs nas/ / byang chub rdzon pa'i 'bras gya smin mdzad de/ / phan bde'i dge mtshan bskrun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i phyag gis btud zhin ma las skabs su 'bab pa'i zhu ni 'di yang spyir zhangangopa'i bstan pa dar ba'i yul tshu dang lhag par du nga bcas ra'i 'grag rgyal khab nang sku gsung thugs rten zer tshogs bsags gyi zhing sangs rgyas dkon mtshog gyi ya gyal thugs rten mchod rten gyi rigs ma 'duwa le sha yod mi tshu gi dbye ba dang de'i khungs dang dgos pa tshu gi lo rgyus dum gra cig zhu ni in/nya thugs rten zer slab dgos pa'i khungs/ mtshod rten lu thugs rten zer zhu dgos mi 'di rgyal ba'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshu thugs kyi ngo so dbyings spros pa dang bral ba'i chos sku ye shes lnga ldan gyi bdag nyid snang stong zung 'thug gi rang bzhin can yin rung gzhan don wu 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du yid bzhin gyi nor gya dang dpag bsam gyi shing bzum gang la gang 'dul gyi 'gro ba'i don rgyun chad med par mdzad ni gi don thu sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las kyi 'jug pa bsam gyis mi khyab par ston te gnang ba'i gral las gdul byu thun mong gi snang ngor rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de tshu gi rgyud wu mnga' ba'i byang chub phyogs kyi chos sum cu so bdun la sogs pa'i spangs rtogs kyi yon tan tshu brda 30

dang rtags kyi tshul du pyi khar ston pa'i thugs khyo rnam pa'i brda mtshon gyi rten 'di thu thugs rten zer zhuwa yin mas/de bzum ma'i rgyal ba'i thugs kyi phrin las kyi cha shas de lhar bcas 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams bsags pa'i zhing / mthong thos dun reg tsam gyis las nyon sdig grib zad de sa'/ ba mchog gi go 'phang khu dathugs dbyung ba'i 'dren pa/ gyi nang gi rkyen bar chad ga ra sel ba'i kyibs gnas kyi rten/ 'jig rten gyi lams 'di na lu mchod par mas pa'i dngos po ga ra gi nang las ma chog tu gyur pa'i rten inam las mchod rten zer yang zhuwa in/mchod rten gyi rigs/ de yang gdung sras phrin las nor thus mdzad pa'i bdud 'dul g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod rte na chen mo'i dkar chag nor 9thu bai ḍūr+ya'i do shal shog grangs 60gral 'a3thung 'dren springs mi nang / byin rlabs dngos tshib 'byung ba dang / /theg pa so so'i mchod rten lnga/ /zer gsungs yodapa bzum spyir mtshod rten gyi rigs lu rang bzhin lhun yib kyi mtshad rten / bla na med pa'i mtshod rten/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod rten/dngos yib/ byung ba'i mchod rten/ theg pa so so'i mchod rten zer lnga thu gsungs te yod mi las dang pa bla med rgyud gyi dgongs pa dang 'khril ba cin gnas lugs kyi bden pa gzigs shing snang tshul dag pa'i rnal 'byor pa tshu khu/ khyi snod kyi 'jig rten lams gsum po 'di yang mchod rten cig gi rnam par gnas te yod pa dang / de bzum sge nang bcud kyi sems can tshu yang ga ra mchod rten gyi rnam par gnas te gzigs do yod mi 'di khu rang bzhin lhun tshib kyi mchod rten 31

zer rdo lja bkod pa'i rgyud las gsungs nug /'a rnal 'gyor rgyud kyi dgongs pa dang 'khril ba cin gling bzhi'i 'jig rten gyi lams tshad med bzhi la spyar ba'i mchod rten ni/ shar thus 'phags po byams pa tshad med rdo rje brtsegs pa'i mchod rten/ lto 'dzam gya gling snying rje tshad med rin chen brtsegs pa'i mtshad rten/ nub ba lang spyod dga' ba tshad med pad+mo brtsegs pa'i mchod rten/ byang sgra mi snyan btang sloms tshad med rgya gram brtsegs pa'i mcho da rten ze ra brtsi srol yod mi tshu bla na med pa'i mchod rten zer thig le dbang gi rgyud las gsungs nug /gling bzhi'i sku gdung cha brgyad kyi mtshod rten ni shar lus 'phags na gyin ldan snyoms gter dang mthar legs g.yul drung tog gi mchod rten da nga lto 'dzam gling na thugs rje sprul pa dang yid bzhin lhun mib kyi mtshad rten dang nub ba lang spyod na dpe med bsam 'das dang med grags chos dbyings kyi mchod rten dang /byang sgra mi snyan na yon tan rin chen brtsegs dang khams gsum bde rgyas rga na me'i mchod rten tshu byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod rten yin zer 'khol lo byung ba'i rgyud las gsungs nug /'dzam gling gi yul so so'i dur khrod chen po brgyad wu ma mo chen po brgyad kyi rten du byung ba'i mchod rten/ yul ma gha lha'i dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal lu lha las babs pa'i mchod rten bde byed brtsegs pa/ snye lha'i yul lam siṅga la'i dur khrod sku la rdzogs wu mchod rten ri bo ta la/ la che'i yul gyi gsang lam mgol ma'i dur khrod bde chen brdal khu mchod rten ka na ka/ bal 32

po'i yul gyi dur khrod lhun yib brtsegs par mcho da rten byu khri la shor ram bya rung la shor za hor yul gyi dur khrod laṅka brtsegs par mchod rten bde byed gzhon nu yib/ o rgyan yul gyi dur khrod pad+ma brtsegs par mchod rten rang byung rang 'od can/ mi yul sing ga gling du dur khrod lo ka brtsegs par rang byung mchod rten ke'u sha sa lnga'i yul gyi dur khrod gsang chen rol pa rang byung mchod rten ka pa ta zer mi tshu dngos khrub byung ba'i mchod rten zer bdud rtsi mchog gi rgyud las gsungs nug / mchod rten de tshu khu dge gnas brgyad kyi mchod rten zer yang zhuwa yin mas/5 sku gdung gi mchod rten mdo ta pa myang 'das chen po shog grangs 315rgyab gral 3par gsungs pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i mtshad rten/ dgra bcom pa'i mchod rten/ rang sangs rgyas kyi mtshad rten/ 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i mchod rten tshu dang gzhan yang theg pa so so'i 'dod tshul dang 'khril te brtsi srol yod pa'i mchod rten tshu ga ra theg pa so so'i mtshad rten gyi grangs su tshudapa yin mas/da nga smugs spyo mtshad rten/nya da res 'dzam gling nang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ma gyon pa'i he ma las yod pa'i mchod rten yang 'jam mgon glo gros mtha' yas kyi gsung shes bya kun khyab mdzod kyi glegs bam gnyis pa shog grangs 'a80rgyab las dang thugs mi tshu gis tshe lo bdun khri grub pa'i skabs sangs rgyas gtsug gtor can 'jig rten wu gyonam da shel gyi rang bzhin lu rang byung tshib pa'i li yul 33

gyi ri bo glang ru'i mchod rten rje bo dam pa/ mi tshu gi tshe lo stong phrag gsum khri thub pa'i skabs sangs rgyas gser thub 'jig rten thu gyonam da gong gi mchod rten de khu chos dbyings gsung dbang gi mchod rten zer zhuwa yin mas/ de'i shul lu mi tshu gi tsho lo nyis khri thub pa'i skabs sangs rgyas 'od srung 'jig rten wu gyonam da slob dpon zhi ba'i dpal zer mi gis mtshad rten de mi sa sbungs te gter khu sga bzhag sa las da res nga bcas ra'i ston pa rnam 'dren bzhi pa sangs rgyas shākya thub pa 'jig rten lu gyonam da lung bstan te gnang mi gi yul dge ba'am li yul gyi ri bo glang ru'i mtshad rten snyo mas la lhan da zer mi 'di de yin mas/ shul las dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis dathu sku gtor bzhag sa shing sna kun skye0 las da res nang par mtsha da rten de khu 'phags pa shing kun zer zhu mi 'di nang sangs rgyas rab bdun gyi ring bsrel yang bzhugs yodapa las 'dzam gling nang yod pa'i mchod rten tshu las rnying shos cig 'di yin mas/'a gzungs bsdus shog grangs 111mdun gral 5par stag mos zhus pa'i mdo las sngon bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po de slob pa lam gyi dus wu byung chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod de bzhugs pa'i skabs khu dag pa'i skye ba lnga brgya bzhes te bzhugasapa da tshar gcig 'badawa da rgyal po shing rta chen po'i sras rgyal thu snying stobs can zer mi khu skye ba bzhesapa da stag mo stag phrug lnga yod mi cig khu sku lus spyin par gnang ba'i shul wu mchod rten bzhengs te yod mi khu 34

stag mo lus byin gyi mchod rten zer zhuwa yin/gong khu dngos tshib byung ba'i mchod rten brgyad gyi nang gses bal po'i mtshad rten bya rung la shor zer mi 'di yang sangs rgyas gnyis pa yi ru rin poche pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku tsho snga ma cig lu bya rdzi ma cig ngu bzhi yod pa'i gsum pa lu sku 'khrungasam da gya bzhi gis ma'i drin lan 'gyor thabs wu bzhengs bzhengs pa'i mchod rten yin mas de tshu da res nangs par ga ra bal po'i rgyal khab nang yodapa las bal yul mchod rten rnam gsum zer zhuwa yin/de bzum sge kong yul shes bya mdzod kyi gnas drug pa thos pa'i shes rab bstan pa'i skabs gsung mi nang rgya gar snyo phyogs kyi rgya mtsho'i gling kong ku na zer sa lu dpal reg pa med pa'i macesad rten (5 6 2 )zer mi cig steng gi'iba'i 1bgeji'i skya'i nam mkhar 'ja' tshon gyi rnam par bzhugs te yod pa'i lo rgyus tshu yang 'dug zer zhu ni yin/4 bde bar gshegs pa mtshad rten brgyad/gye brag tu skabs su babs pa bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten tshu gi skor las theg pa chen po'i dbang du btang pa cin 'dzam gling 'di gis gtsos pa'i mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing khams 'di nang bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten byung tshul dang bzhugs tshul bsam gyis mi khyab par yodapa las nga bcas ra gis brjod pa'i yul las 'das rung tshur bsdu ste theg pa ༅ mong gi snang ngo dang bsnyun te nga bcas ra gnas pa'i lto 'dzam gling 'di nang khu byung ba'i mchod rten skor las zhu ba cin dang pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 35

'das 'o ra gis mdzad pa dang bstun te bzhengs pa'i bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad dang sku mya ngan las 'das zhinam las bzhengs pa'i sprin gso'i dad rten gyi sku gdung mtshad rten tshu dang de las da res nangs par nga bcas ra gi chogs bsags sgrib byang dang rkyen ngan bar chad sel ba'i gson po'i rim spo gshin po'i yar 'dren tshu gi don khu bzhengs pa'i mtshad rten tshu dang 'badawa da mtshad rten gyi lham pa ma 'duwa ga sum de cig yodapa yin mas/dang pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mdzad pa sprin gso'i rten du bzhengs pa'i bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad las yang gnas chen bzhi'i mchod rten 'di tshu sangs rgyas 'o ra gis sku tshab bgrum cig 'bad bzhengs dgosapa 'bad bka' gnang nug / de yang bka' 'gyur mdo sde ta pa mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo shog grangs 314mdun gral 'apar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo lu sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i rjes su ring bsrel gyi mchod rten bang rim 13can ma bzhengs dgos par ma tshad/'dul ba da pa lung phran tshegs kyi gzhi shog yings 'a88rgyab gral nyayang sa phyogs 'di bzhi rigs kyi su'am rigs kyi su mo dad pa can rnams kyis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 'gro bar bya zhing 'akro bar bya zhing dun par 'gyur bar bya'o/zhes gang zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'dir ni sku 'grangs so/ / bcom ldan 'das 'dir ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byung chub mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so/ / brtsom ldan 'das 'dir ni lan gsum du bzlas te chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa bcu gnyis su bskor to/ / bcom ldan 'das 'dir ni cing po lhag ma 36

ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /zhes bya ba nas kha cig nga la dad pas dus byas pa thams cad mtho ris su 'gro'o/ /la cig ni cing po lhag ma dang bcas par ro/ / ji ltar mngon du 'gro bar byu ba de ltar rjes su dun par bya'o/zhes sangs rgyas kyi gsungs mi dang 'khril ba'i gnas chen bzhi'i mtshad rten dang gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad chen gzhan bzhi'i mchod rten dang bcas pa de tshu lu bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad zer zhuwa yinam las bstan 'gyur bltod tshogs ka pa shog grangs 81rgyab gral 3par gnas chen po 8kyi mtshad rten skor dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrab kyis gsungs mi nang bkris 'a byung ba'i mchod rten/ byang chub chen po'i mchod don/ mas 'khor mtshad rten/ rkyo 'phrul mchod rten/ lha bab mchod rten/ dgyen bzlums mchod rten/ sku tshe byin brlabs mtshad rten/ myang 'das mtshod rten zer brgyad gsungs nug / de bzhin du las kyi mtha' brdzod pa'i mdo las yang bde bar gshegs pa'i mtshad rten brgyad zer gsungs mi tshu ga ra cog 'thadapa yinam las re re bzhin du zhu ba cin/37
byung chub mtshad rten che na byerte —'eb
—da shege~X/——snye/ che na sam
cho 'bye /chen po'i mchod rten che/

da res nangs pa rgyal khab so so'i nang khu mchod rten ma 'duwa ga de sge rang yod rung gtso go yongs grags gong khu zhu mi bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad po de tshu rang yin rung nga bcas ra'i rgyal lab nang 'badan dus rabs 17pa'i nang rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas gyis bde gshegs mtshad rten 8kyi dpye bzhengs bzhin na las tshu mtshad rten ga te rang bzhengs rung bzo rnam de las rigs 'gres to ha lam cog 'thadapa mtshams cig rang yod rung rgyal lab gzhan khu thig tshad dang bzo rnam ma 'duwa ga de sbre yang 'ongam yin mas/dper na sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das te nya'aXskor cha lu sangs rgyas zhal mjal myong gi bram ze gi am dza se zer mi gi thu gsum gyi chung shos dge ba zer mi 'di gis bzhings mi rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi mchod rten dang myang ngan med kyis bzhengs pa'i wa ra na si'i mchod rten sangs rgyas las chos dngos su zhu mi tshong dpon ga gon dang bzang po gnyis kyis sangs rgyas kyi dngu sku dang sen mo zhu ste bar ma'i rgyal khab nang bzhengs pa'i gser gyi mtshad rten (gol dren pe ko du)dang beng kog dang siṅga la khu yod pa'i sangs rgyas gyi tshems gyi mtshod rten tshu dang yin du ni she ya nang dus rabs bcu pa tsam zhig wu bzhings pa'i (nyo ro thu du)mchod rten tshu ga ra bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad ga dang yang ma 'duwa 'bad bzhengs te yod mi tshu gis ha go tshugs pas zer zhu ni yin/ gzhan yang mi ru rin po che dgra sku bsilawa da bzhengs pa'i spru gris gtam pa'i mchod rten bod rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis 'gyod tshangs lu bzhengs pa'i zung mkhar rdo'i mchod rten dang gtsang gi byang rtse dpal 'khor mchod rten 'grag 42

gi g.yang rtse mchod rten bskor ra dang tsan dan sbris kyi mtshad rten sku re zam dang grang ma'i zam gyi mchod rten la sogs pa dang cigs las bzhengs pa'i mchod rten mang rabs cig yod mi tshu bzo rnam ma 'duwa so sor yod mi tshu mang shos ra mchod rten bya rung kha shor lu dpe 'bad de bzhengs bzhengasapa da la wu cig mdo rgyud dang gter kha so so'i zhal rgyun dang 'khril te bzhengs bzhengasam mang ni yin mas zer zhu ni yin/ garnyas pa jun gas rten snye sku gcing mar rten/ sku gdung mtshad rten zer mi 'di sngon rgya gar gyad kyi yul rtswa can gyi sang khyer nang lu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das glu mya ngan las 'da' te sku gdung me mtshod bzhes tshar ba'i shul wu sangs rgyas kyi tshems che ba bzhi me mchod ma bzhes pa'i lar sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel yul ma lha lha'i bre sgom 8thon mi de tshu spyan bdag tshu gi dad pa'i rten 'bad dpya brgyad lu bgo bsha' rkyab ste zhu 'bag song zhin na mchod rten re bzhengs ni 'di gis sku gdung cha brgyad zer zhuwa yin mas/ 1 ring bsrel tshu tsa go brgyad lu bgo bsha' rkyab pa'i sku gdung mchod rten 8 gyi la lu sku gdung btsugs pa'i shom gyi sum pa las sum pa'i mtshad rten/kri gdung zhugs khu zhen pa'i sol mu las sol ba'i mchod rten/ sku gdung me mtshad phyalawa da sku gzugs lu shing bal dang ras stong gis dkyis te bzhag mi las shing bal tshu dang ras ga ra gi nang ma dang phyi ma gnyis ma tshig par yod mi las ras tshig pa dang ma tshig pa'i mtshad rten/ ras tshig pa'i gzhob tshu las ras gzhob 43 —

mchod rten/ sprur thal tshu las thal ba'i mchod rten tshu bzhengs nug / de las tshems che ba nyalha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis sum cu tsa gsum lha yul du bsnam/ tshems gcig tshig 'dzin sang khyer yid 'ong gi rgyal po dang / tshems gcig ka ling ka/ 'i rgyal po dang / tshems gcig spong khyer sgra sgrogs kyi klu'i rgyal po tshu gis zhu 'bag ste tshems kyi mchod rten bzhengs bzhengam tshu ga ra sku gdung mchod rten yin mas/de gi lo rgyus tshu mdo da pa myang 'das chen po'i nang bstan pa bzhag pa'i le'u nang las dang 'a dul ba da pa thung phran tshegs gyi gzhi bam po 55pa tshu nang thu gsungs nug /'a sangs rgyas myang ngan las 'das te lo 100song ba'i shul khu chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis rgyal sto ma skyes dgra'i skal ba'i ring bsrel rgyal yo'i khab kyi 'od ma'i tshal gyi mchod rten 'og khu yod mi de bton te snan ci'i mchod rten dang wa ra na si sod wu dngu ru snyugs rum mtshod rten shes rig las khungs kyi 1993lo' 'grag gi rgyal rabs shog grangs 10pa'i don ltar gyi 'byug rgyal lab nang shar ra dza 'og gi mchod rten la sogs pa 'dzam gling nang sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel can gyi sku gdung mtshad rten bye ba bzhengs te spyo 'gro sems can dpag tu med pa'i las don byung nug /3 gzhan yang nga bcas ra'i 'grag rgyal khab nang dus rabs 8pa'i nang spa kro stag tsha nga lu gshags mi yi ru rin po che'i slob ma rje 'bangs 'dzi'i nang gses glang chen dpal seng gi sku gdung mtshad rten/ stang a nu lha khang gdan sa bcag mi a na'i sku gdung mtshod rten dus rabs 13par rdo dkar 'grag lams 44

brag spyil dkar gsang sngags chos slong dgon par tshib thob spyil dkar ba'i sku gdung mchod rten/ dus rabs 16pa'i nang gyon mi gter chen pad ma gling pa dang sras grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sku gdung mtshad rten spru na la dang g.yung drung chos gling khu yodapa ma tshad/ smra mkhar thu thugs sras zla ba dang sbris gdung khu mkhas tshib kun dga' dbang po/ dgra med rtse khu a ne+e mchod rten bzang mo/ stag rtsi lar sras gsang bdag tshu gi sku gdung mtshad rten dang u ra som phrang khu rgyal ba lha nang pa'i gdung rgyud tshu gi sku gdung mchod rten tshu yod pa'i khar/lhag par du dus rabs 17pa'i nang gyon pa'i 'grag rgyal lab kyi chos srid bstan pa gtso bo dpal 'grag pa rin po che zhabs drug ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi sku gdung yang da res nangs par sku gdung mchod rten nang bzhugs gsol zhu ba'i bsgang yod mi gis gtsos pa'i gzhan yang dus rabs 18par rta log gsang sngags mas gling dgon par zhabs sprul 'jigs med grags pa'i sku gdung mtshod rten dang zhabs sprul 'jigs med chos rgyal gyi sku gdung mchod rten/gtam zhing du grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sras kyi sku gdung spyabs khra cha 'og thu gter bston 'grag sgu rdo rje'i spar thal mchod rten/ spang pa'i sar gter bston shes zhengarab me 'bar gyi sras nam mkha' rdo rje'i sku gdung / sum thang sums pa'i lha lang khu ban chen mkhan po bde gling dgon pa khu sgo lo mkhan rin po che/ spa khro sa mtshams mchod rten lu dil mgo mkhyen brtse rin po che'i sbur thal mchod rten bzhugs yod mi tshu ga ra kri gdung mchod rten gyi grangs su bci ni yinam ma tshad de khar nga bcas ra'i rgyal sa thim phyag khu yod pa'i dgongs rdzogs mchod rten 45

tshu yang ma pa rgyal khab kyi sku rim don khu bzhengs bzhengasapa yin rung da res nangs par zhing phebs 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug gi dun gso'i rten thu cha bzhag ni 'di gis sprin gso'i dad rten gyi mtshad rten grangs su bsdu ni yin no/ju gsum pa mchod rten gzhan gyi skor/gong khu mtshad rten gyi dbye ba gnyis nang ma tshud mi tshu la lu cig rang gi tshogs gsog sgrib byung gi don khu dang la lu cig gshin po'i dgongs rdzogs la wu cig gson po'i rim 'gro la wu cig nag phyogs bdud kyi la gnon la thu cig bstan pa dang rgyal khab kyi mtha' don lu 'bad mchod rten gyi rigs 'du mi 'du mang rabs cig bzhengs srol yodapa yin/de tshu las nga bcas ra'i 'grag rgyal khab nang lu yang dang phyags kyi mkha' 'khro ma'i mchod rten/ chos thugs so so khu brten pa'i ka dam mtshad rten/khang bzang ngam lang gzugs mchod rten/ ma ṇi gdang ring ma'i mchod rten/ rigs gsum mgon po'i mchod rten/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i mtshad rten/ sri bzlog mchod rten/ mchod rten rkang gnyisam la sogs pa'i mchod rten gyi rnam grangs dang bzo dbyibs kyi dbye ba ma 'du ba bsam gyis mi khyab par yod mi tshu ga ra gis mkhyen sar yin zer zhu ni yin/4 mtshad rten snye zig tshad dang brda don/nya mchod rten gyi thig tshad kyang yongs grags khu sku lus kyi tshad dang mag par bzhengs srol yodapa las/ de'i dpya bgo dbye tshad tshu gdung sras phrin las ma nor ngu'i bdud 'dul g.yul las rnam rgyal gyi mchod rten chen mo'i dkar chag 46

nang dus 'khor gyi lung dungs mi las/ gsang ba'i chu skyes mdzod sbu'i mtha' yis mchog gi rgyal ba'i bdag po'i mchod rten dpang gi tshad/ / de'i phyed gī gdan gyi rgya ste sa gzhi shin tu mnyam pa de'i gsum chas phyogs cha rnams/ / phyed dang gnyis mthar phyir 'bur chu skyes thugs mar gnas pa'i khor yug gdan gyi tshad kyi zlum po'o/ / gzhi dang mnyam pa'i pad+ma'i mtha' yis chas dman 'og pa de'i phyogs cha yin kyang mgrin pa'o/ / gdan stegs cha yis gdong stegs sa gzhi shin tu mnyam pa de yi gsum chas phyogs cha'o gsang ba yi/ / chu skyes dag las phyed chas nyi mas gdan gyi dpangs kyi tshad de shin tu mnyam pa yang 'di 'gyur/ / gdan sa pad+mo'i mngon mtshams thugs khar gnas pa'i khor yug mtha' dang de nas mgrin pa'i rtsa ba'o/ / de nas gdong gi mthar ni de bzhin chu gter phyed chas dus dang rig byed rnams kyi dum thu gsum/ / gdan las rig byed kyis ni pad+ma'i thugs khar gnas pa'i khor yug mgrin pa'i tshad kyang de bzhin te/ / phyed bcas brgyad kyis gdong pa'i tshad dang de yi steng du gdugs kyi phreng bar 'gyur ro mi yi dbang / / mdzod sbu mtshams nas dpral ba dag dang spyi so de nas 'dir ni gtsug tor dag gi mthar thug 'di/ / de ltar nges par 'jig rten lams 'di mtha' dag rgyal ba'i sku ste 'khor lo mtshad rten rang bzhin no/ / zer gsungasam bzhin du yin/'a de dang 'du bar brda donayang ma pa las rang thugs rten 'di rgyal ba'i thugs rgyud wu mnga' ba'i byang chub phyogs kyi chos sum cu so bdun po'i rang bzhin brda rtags kyi dbyibs lu phyir stonam da mtshad rten enam las brten/ gong khu zhu mi gi mchod rten dkar chag shog grangs 63par rig 'dzin pad+ma dbang chen gyi 47

gsung lung 'dren 'bad springs mi las/ zlum po'i dbyibs su byas pa kun/ / spros pa'i mtshan ma nyer bzhi'i don/ / tshi bzhi'i dbyibs su byas pa kun/ / spros pa'i mtshan ma nyer bzhi'i don/ / h+phu bzhi'i dbyibs su byas pa kun/ / spangs rtogs yon /tan rdzogs pa'i brda/ / dge bcu thar pa'i ming rten nas/ / bang rim bzhi yo rim pa bzhin/ / dun pa nyer bzhi yang dag sgongs/ / rdzu 'gral rkang pa dbang po lnga/ /sum gdan ltobs lnga sum pa ni/ / byang chub yan lag bdun du mtshon/ / dre ni 'phags lam yan lag brgyad/ / shes bcu ltobs bcu ma 'dren pa'i/ / dun pa nyer bzhag gsum rim bzhin/ / thugs rje kyibs pa char khebs gdugs/ / nyi zla 'jig rten thun sel 'od/ / tog ni 'gran zla bral ba'i rtags/ / zhes gsungs mi tshu bzum yin mas zer zhu ni yin/ /byugs rten mtshad rten snye dgos pa dang phan can/nya bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad dang gzhan yang mchod rten ga ci rang en rung so so'i lugs kyi thig tshad dang ldan par bzhengs zhin na las srog shing dang gzungs zhugs la sogs pa tshul mthun 'phrul dgo/ de yang gtso bo rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel yinam las brten ring bsrel gyi snying po can zer mdo rgyud tshu gi nang las thon mi bzum 'bad tshugs pa cin mchog tu gyur pa yin mas/ de ma byung rung gzung sngags glegs bam la sogs pa chos kyi ring bsrel/ glu rten ye shes sems dpa' sa tsha mchod rten sogs chos kyi sku'i ring bsrel/ sha ri ram la sogs pa'i 'phel gdung tshu yung 'gyu lta thu'i ring bsrel te rnam pa lnga gang rung dang / lhag par chos kyi ring bsrel gzung sngags 48

glegs bam rnams dang yung 'gru lta ngu'i ring bsrel tshu gal che zer rten ga sum khu gzungs zhugs phrul thangs kyi rnam bshad mdzod chen sde lnga'i nang gsungs gnang nug /'a de bzum ma'i gzungs rang yod pa cin rgyu bzang ngan gyi thad dngos yo'i gnas gong gi dbang du brtsi ba'i skabs gal che chung yod rung byin rlabs dang dngos gyub che chung gi la thug las brtsi ba cin dad mos che chung khu rags las pa ma gtogs rgyu lu bzang ngan med par 'du b.rabartsilnga yinam las dad pa yodan khyi'i so las yang ring bsrel 'khrungs zer ba'i dpye gtam bzum en/ yin rung ca rnying 'dzin spyong sde tshan gyi srid byus dang 'khrilawa da rgyu bzang las tshib pa'i rten tshu byin rlabs dang dngos tshib che ba kyang po gis ma do bar rgyal khab kyi nang gter nor gya dang 'du ba'i sa bcud kyi rang bzhin yinam las/ rgyu legs zhim tshu bdag 'dzin logs su 'thab dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di las brten te yin zer zhu ni yin/ spe' de bzum ma'i thugs rten mchod rten tshu/ spyir rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba de tshu gis nga bcas rang 'gro ba bsod nams gsog pa'i rten du mdzad gnang ba yinam las/ mtshad rten bzhengs ni dang de lu kyibs zhu ni phyag mchod bkur sti tshu 'bad de tha na mthong ba dang sos pa reg pa tsam gyis rang rgyud kyi las ston bag chags dang bcas pa sbyang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tsholags bsags te mthar thug 'bras gya rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i dgos pa dang / ba/nas skabs dus kyi zhud pa zhi zhing mi 'jigs pa'i 49

kyibs byin/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal yon stsol ba dang tshe srog bsring zhing rkyen ngan bar chad zhi ba la sogs pa 'phral phyags ga ra thu phan sgogs sgom yodapa las brten te/ nga bcas ra'i rgyal khab nang lha lang dang khyim nang gi mchod bshams tshu nang khu ga ra gis thugs rten re bzhengs pa ma tshad/ de tshu mi ga mnotha gis mjal mi tshugs pas mno ste gzhung lam gyi sbugs/ri mgo'i rtse/ chu chen gyi 'gram/ lung pa'i mdo la sogs pa ga ste lu yang mtshad rten 'du mi 'du tshu bzhengs gnang mi 'di mi mang 'gro ba sems can ga ra gis /'jam tong to mjal tshugs smon lam btab tshugs phyag mtshad zhabs tog phrul tshugs pa'i don khu dang tha na mchod rten tshu khu phog pa'i rlung ma gis nga bcas mor dang 'gro ba sems can tshu khu yog rung de'i rgyud kyi las nyon sdig sgrib dag pa'i dgos pa yodapa yin/de gis ma do ba nga bcas ra'i rgyal khab nang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi khungs don dang 'khril ba'i lam lugs srol las brten te khyim gyi sa cig bcad rung nyes pa kun thub kyi don khu sku gsung thugs rten dgo rten 'brel bzangamo ga ci cig brtsi rung sku gsung thugs rten dgo / de bzum a lo cig khyim ma'i phyir bton rung lam zhugs cig 'bad dgo rung tha na dur khrod khu ro cig bton dgo rung sku gsung thugs kyis sna dungs te 'bad ba cin legs shom 'ong ni gi rten 'brel yod ni 'di gis de sge 'bad srol yodapa las brten/ 'grag gi rang srol bzang po'i lam lugs kyi mdzad sgo ga ci gi nang khu yang thugs rten mchod rten 'di med thabs med par dgosapa yin/50

3 thugs rten mchod rten bzhengasam da dang de lnga bsnyen bkur zhabs tog sgrub mi tshu las brten te rang khu phan yon sgom thob ni yod mi 'di yang / nga bcas ra gis tshul dang masto pa'i mchod rten sgom 'bad bzhengs pa cin phan yon sgom ma'i lo rgyus slab mi dgo pas/ chung ku cig las ma bzhengs rung phan yon sgom yod pa'i lo rgyus mdo sa pa 'phags pa med du byung ba'i shog grangs 195gral 5par bcom ldan 'das kyis/ kun dga' bo/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi lams yod de/ de rigs kyi gya'am rigs gyi gya po gang la la zhig gis rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin du byas te rgyun du zhugs pa rnams dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams dang / phyir mi 'ong ba rnams dang / dgra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la thul bas gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtshad rten 'ji ba skyu ru ra'i 'bras ngu tsam byas la/ lab tsam gyi srog shing btsugs te rgya shugs kyi lo ma tsam gyi gdugs byas nas/ nas gyi 'gyu tsam gyi sku gzugs byas la yung 'gra tsam gyi ring bsrel btsugs na de ni de bas bsod nams che zhes nga smra'o zer gsungs nug / mchod rten gyi rgyu gser dngul tshu las bzhengs pa cin phan yon sgom de rang mim rgyu dman pa sa dang shing gis rtsed mo rtse ba'i zhor lar mtshad rten tshu bzhengs rung phan yon sgom yod pa'i lo rgyus mdo ja pa dam chos pami dkar po shog grangs 'a10gral 'apa thabs la mkhas pa'i le'u las shā ri sus gsol ba'i lan du/ gang gis mtshad rten rdo las byas pa dang / / gang gis a ka ru dang 51

tsan dan nam/ / gang gis thang shing mchod rten bya sa pa dang / / la las shing mang gzhan las byas pa dang / / sa dang so phag las ni brtsigs pa yis/ / rgyal ba 'i mchod rten dga' zhing byas pa dang / / de bzhin sa rdul tshang po dag las kyang / /skya ngam dgon pa dag tu byas pa dang / / gis pa'i rtsed mor de dang de dag tu/ /gang gis byas pa de phyir mchod rten dag / bye ma las ni cing yor byas pa yang /de rnams kyis kyang byang chub thob par 'gyur/ / zer gsungs nug /4 de bzum 'a bad phyag mchod zhabs tog sgrub pa'i phan yon yang / mdo sde sa pa gsal rgyal gyis nus lan tshigs su bcad pa shog grangs 'aX3gal 'apa las su zhig dad pas thub pa'i mchod rten nam/ / sku gzugs dag la bskor ba byed pa de/ / phyi ma'i tshe la dgra chen rnam sa kyis btud/ / bzang po'i snod 'gyur yon tan rnams dang dzordon/ / mi rnams su dag dga' zhing yis pa yis/ / bla med mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la/ / lus kyi las rnams byed pa de dag ni/ / srid pa kun tu mdzod rnams shin tu rgyas/ / zhes dang / dam chos pad dkar shog gra ngas 'a'amadun gral 5pa las yang / bde gshegs ring bsrel la ni cung zad dang / / sil snyan gcig brdungs pa yi smra phyung ngam/ / me tog gcig tsam gyis ni mtshad pa dang / /bde gshegs gzugs dag rtsig ngos bris pa la/ / 'khrugs bzhin pa yis sems kyis mchod na yang / / de dag rim gyis sangs rgyas bye ba mthong / / mchod rten dag la gang gis thal mo spyar/ / yongs su tshang ba'am thal mo ya gcig gam/ / yang na mgo so skad cig btud pa dang / / bde bzhin lan gcig thus kyang btud pa dang / /gang gis ring bsrel gnas pa de dag la/ / g.ye nga ba'i sems kyis sangs rgya sa

phyag 'tshal zhes/ / tshig gcig lan 'ga' brdzod par byas pa yang / / de dag kun gyis byang chub mchog 'di thob/ /la sogs pa mdo dang rgyud sde tshu las phan yon mang rabs cig gsungs yod sri las/ da lto nga bcas ra'i nang thu sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gnas tshad ma rdzogs par yodapa las rten de tshu mjal ni dang phyag mchod 'phrul ni'i go skabs yodapa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 'khol mar gsung mi las/de phyir sangs rgyas ma gyon pa'i / / zhing na sku gzugs yod min zhing / / mtha' 'khobs kla klo rnam sa na med/ / bstan pa nub na yod min zhi nga / / yu stegs rgyal song sogs mi mthong / / zer gsungs yodapa bzum bstan pa'i gnas tshad rdzogs song pa cin bstan pa'i btsas sku gsung thugs kyi rten de tshu mkha' 'gro ma tshu gis zhing lams gzhan khu gdan 'dren zhu ste nga bcas ra gis mjal sar mi 'ong /de bzum sge gal srid nga bcas ra tshu mtha' 'khobs kla klo'i g.yus dang sangs rgyas gyi bstan pa ma dar sa tshu nang skye ba cin rten gsum gyi ming tsam rna bar go ni'i go skabs yang mi thob/ da res nga bcas ra tshu las dang skal ba sgom yodapa las brten te dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob mas ldan 'grag gi yul lu skye ba'i dga' tshor khu rten de tshu wu brten te las ngan ma bsags par tshogs bsags che sgyu ba chung sgrub khu brtson ni 'di ga ni ba gal che bas zer zhu ni/pa 'a di dang cha de mtha' 'jug zhu don snying po 'di rang ca rnying 'dzin skyong gi phyag lā gnang mi tshu gis gong du zhu mi gnad don tshu thugs lar bzhag ste rgyal ba'i thugs rten de tshu gal che ba dang phan yon che ba med thabs med pa rgyal khab nang 53

gi nor gya dang 'du ba 'di tshu la 'thor brlag stor zhugs ma bcug par bdag 'dzin 'thab tshugs thabs wu khra deb bkod ni gi lā nang che chung dang bzo rnam gyi dgye ba tshu par btab rgyu bzang ngan dang dus skabs tshu la gsal bkod de gzhung gi dmigs don nga bcas ra'i lnga 'gan tshu btags sar kyil tshugs pa 'bad dgo pa'i sprin gso zhu ni dang bcas nge'i la thug las thugs rten mchod rten dang de'i khungs dang dgos ma tshu bde gshegs mchod rten gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i 8 don tshan nang mdor bsdus te zhu tsharawa yin lags/ bkris bde legs/sangs rgyas rdo rje/dung che rdzong lag gong 'phel lhan tshogs/54

rdzoX9da )kyidaben4 ) 7 )nga (kag de༄ 0sdo'o( sgro bye sto1/ ri la( 5shi —r+sha/ / snyecarkyu —— ——— tshakhri ri kā ) 〉 po sto / 4 4 ༄7)/ gre (rlochis rwagerna da/re'i ba༄tre ge bge ji nga kodalo(du — sde 'i she she sko rneca༄99nyuge/ shi'agrug pa kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar bo/a mkhyen bad+ma gtso gusung ldi ma brtag pa'i rab byedasmra bu 'dad pa' kha rgyan zhasakhya ba bzhugs go//55

kun misnyen pasmi da kar sa gcing blu yi brtag pa rab snyed 'dod pa' la rgyan zhes spya ba bzhugs thos /༄༄ / thugs rje'i chu gter zas gtsang sras gyi gru/ / 'jam mgon snying stobs rdzogs pa'i zla ba ni/ / smra malas 'dod pa'i snying la bdud rtsi'i gyun/ / gsar pa rgyun mkhas de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / brtag pa sbrang rtsi'i nying khu 'thungs gyur pa'i/ dbyangs can lang 'tsho rgyas pa'i spyo so ni/ / chen sa mdun sar ya mtshan gtam gleng tshe/ / khugs shes yur spru bzhin du grags par ltaragyur/ / lus can bsod nams myu yi'i zhing gyur pa'i/ / rgyal dang de sras sku rten sngon byung ba/ / rnam par dbye tshe kun gyi dbyangs can ma/ / thob pa'i rig byed tshangs pas ma sprin 'di'o/ / rgya gar sod dang hor dang rgya nag bzhi/ / rgya gar la yang dgus gyur shar nub dang / /lto byung re re spyi dang bye brag dbye/ / dngus gyur yul du zi khyim li dmar dang / /li dkar zangs dmar byang chub shing dang ni/ / klu 'jim rdo ba dag las bsgrubs pa ste/ / zi khyim sin rgyu'i chu klung dag gi 'gram/ / gser bzhin chags pas gser dmar yin par grags/ / 'di la klu yi rin chen sna bdun yo/ / ma thus 'dus pas yid bzhin nor gya bzhin/ / la dog cher dmar zhib brtags 'ja' 'od snang / /dug chus reg na dbang po'i gzhu nyid ston/ / li dmar dmar mdangs cung zad ser ba dang / / li dkar dkar mdangs cung zad ser ba yin/ / 'di gnyis li yul ri la thub dbang gis/ / byin gyis brlabs pa las 'ong mchog tu bsngags/ /sku sha li dkar na bza' li dmar gyis/ / byas pa dag la zangs thang ma zhes 'thod/ /zangs dmar rtogs sla byang chub ljon shing gi / yal ga las mib 'di reg ngan so nga med/ / ngang zhing 'gol ba klu yi 'jim pa dang / / de shākya thub pas smon lam btab pa'i phyir ro/ / dkar zhing mkhregs pa kā ma ru pa'i rdo/ / rdo mnyen nag po 56

bsil ba'i tshal nas 'ong / / thub pa'i kri tshusas sngon tshe thub dbang gis/ / ri mo mkhan la grir bcug ma nus pas/ / rang gi kri dang 'tsham pa'i 'od zer bkye / /de steng ri mos mnan pa'i bris sku zhib/ ga/ ci/ṅga li rgyal thu mo'i skyes lan gnang / /'di rigs skem sgeg rtsoms shing lho tig 'khri shing zer gtsug tor spring / / shangs rgyud mtho zhing spyang la shangs rtse rno/ / ma dzod sbu shangs rtse thig btab bzhin du dung / /spyan bar dog cing mchu gos gtsang ba dang / / spyol ming mtha' thig shangs rtser reg pa dang / / na bza' phal cher sha mi sgrib pa mang / / lha sa'i rngo be+e rin chen 'di rigs yin/ / gotres 'khyud nyung bas kri sha sgrib pa'ang srid/ / gzhan pa gzugs can snying pos sgra skyogs kyi/ / rgyal po'i skyes lan thub pa'i sku bris tshe/ / ma ga lha'i rgyal yo/ u spri pa na tsan dan rdzo bo bzhings mkhan de ka yin/ / gris mkhan rnams gyis ma nus thub pa nyid/ / chu 'gram bzhugs nas de nang gzugs brnyan la/ /brten nas brir bcug chu lon ma zhes grags/ / 'di la dathu dpral brdal zhing spyil ming thig / mdzod sngar reg pa khyad chos gzhan rnams mtshungs/ / grub dbang lha gnas gso spyong mdzad pa'i tshe/ / gsal ldan zhes byu wā ra / si ru/ / rgyal po u spri ya nas sprin rten du/ / tsan dan las byas thub pa'i kri bzhengs pa/ / thub pa/ lha babs de yis gom drug bsus/ / tsan dan rdzo bor grags shing de rigs kyi/ / rtses thang gi thub pa gser gling ma 'di rigs/ / tshugs bzang gos 'khyud zhib snyoms phyag mnyen zhing / / zhabs mthil rgyags shing zhal ras dkyus ring ba'i/ / gi yi sha bzhin bzos pa zhig kyang 'byung / / 'di rigs stod hor zer ba 'khrul pa yin/ / byung sems kri la 'gying bag cung zad yod/ /57

tshugs bzang zhal ras mdzes shing skem sgeg ran/ / ral pa'i thor tshugs dung po rgyan gyis smras/ / nor thu gnyis pa'ang re re srid pa ste/ / khro so'i gzugs kyang 'gying bag 'tsham pa yin/ / khri med pa'am yod la yid dang ni/ / seng sogs rgyan bkod tshan sum chogs pa dang / / gdong gsum pa'ang 'asol gyi gdan can dang / / pad gdan yod rnams pad la rgyas zhum stoms/ /nyis brtsegs ya pad ma pad 'grig par nges/ / yar mar yu tig che snyoms bsgrigs legs pa/ / mdor na rgas gtsang mthong bas ngo mtshar baspyod/ / bye brag rdo rje gdan pas bzhengs pa yi/ / gdan chung mar grags li dkar 'ba' zhig ste/ / cung zad dathu chung zhal ras mthur chos rgyags/ / ma ga lhar ni thub dbang bdud 'dul dang / / chos 'khor ma ni wā ra / sir dang / /dathus 'gyur shar phyogs dpral mtshams dbyes phyed cing / / sku ltod rgyas pas ri dgas rgyal sa 'du/ / zhal dkyus cung thung phyag sor spri bas 'brel /yid tsam gtsug tor rgyab tu nye ba yin/ / rgya gar shar gyogs phal che ra li dkar te/ / li dmar las byas srid mtha' ma bkag tsam/ / kā ma ru'i rdo las tshib pa yang / / thugs gtsang rgyan gyi bkod pa thun sum chogs/ /zhal gyi sgo mdzes spyan bar cung zad dog / shangs stod dpangs dma' shangs slad cung zad mtho/ / dathus phyogs pa las shangs rgos cung zad 'dal/ /skem zhing tshugs bzang 'gying bag lhu tshig ran/ / gos 'khyud sku la 'khril zhing zhib rtsing ran/ / gtsug tor rgyab tu nye ba 'ba' zhig ste/ / khri sogs dngus kyi lha dang mtshungs pa la/ / pad 'dab nyis brtsegs pad la cung 58

zad zhum/ / ya pad ma pad ma 'grig par nges shing / / yas kyi mu tig zhib sams mas phyogs kyi/ / mu tig rags rtsoms dasus las cung mi ga tsang / / khri gdan gdong gsum rgyab yol yod pa'ang srid/ / shar phyogs bye brag za hor yul gyi lha/ / li dkar shar phyogs lha rigs gtsang ma la/ / gser dngul zangs kyi gi yi sha bzhi bzos/ / dngul zangs spyan 'byed byas dang la cig la/ / yu tig do shal rin chen khra khung spus/ /mtshog tu yi gar 'ong ba 'ba' zhig 'byung / / 'ga' zhig ḍi li'i lha zer 'khrul pa ste/ /ḍi li nub phyogs yul gyi bye brag yin/ / rgya gar nub phyogs la che'i yul gyi lha/ / li dkar cung zad ser dang lhag par du/ / li dmar rdo dang gi yi sha 'du dang / /zi khyim dag kyang 'di la mang bar snang / /sku yi tshugs rigs zhal ras ring zhing tsho/ / stod smad chung dang spyan bar dog pa dang / / shangs gyi sgang zlum bzang dang zhal mchu mthug / 'gying bag bde nyams chung zhing lhu tshigs thung / / phyag zhabs mnyen zhing zangs mchu dngul spyan mang / / na bza' sku la 'khril zhing gos 'khyud ring / /rags zhib 'tsham la gtsug tor nor thu nub/ / yu tig thod bcings yu tig do shal dang / / me tog rgyan gyis smras pa'ang srid pa yin/ / pad+ma dbyig mo chig kyang 'dab ma che/ / pad mgo cung rgyas la sbyar kyang pa'ang srid/ / gdan khri la sogs ci rigs yongs pa yin/ / bye brag tshugs bzang dngus 'gyur lha 'du la/ / masil phra zhal ras sog la dod pa dang / /phyag zhabs spyo mtshams phra zhing zhabs mthil rgyags/ / cher snogs lha rnams 59

phal cher li dmar te/ / li dkar klu 'jim dag kyang srid pa yin/ / zhal ras dkyus thung sog la cung zad yod/ / sha nyam lhod cing spyan bar cung zad yangs/ / shangs kyi gzengs dma' dpral mtshams dbyes mi phyed/ / 'gying bag bde nyams yod pa re re tsam/ / na bza' sku la 'khril zhing gzong ris mang / / khri pad yangs shing pad+ma'i 'dab ma che/ / chig kyang pad mgo cung zad zhum pa la/ / la ser ze'u 'gru zong ris mdzes pa yod/ / la spyar pad kyang ci rigs yod pa yin/ / tsha gser mdog dmar shi na tu 'thug par snang / / pye brag be ta'i yul gyi lha rigs la/ / gzhan rnams snyo phyogs spyi dang 'du ba la/ / zhal ras sog la cung zad chung ba tsam/ / na bza'i rgyan la gzong ris byas pa yod/ / gzhan yang zhal khyim snyo phyogs lha rigs la/ /cung zad dkyus thung spyan che shangs gong nyag / zhal khung kyong zhing mchu skyos cung zad tsong / / rgyan gtsang dar dpyangs na bza' lhub la rag / phyag zhabs sor mo pad+ma'i rgos mi gtsang / / pami nyis brtsegs yar mar gnyis ka ldan/ / steng gi mu tig med pa shas cher 'byung / / sku yi 'gying bag bde nyams dod pa snye/ / shas cher ldem gyi tshul du bzhugs pa mang / / rgya gar byung phyogs li dkar ra gan dang / / cung zad bsres pas rag spya 'du ba la/ /tshugs mnyen 'gying bag bde la zhal ras ni/ / dkyus thung rgas gtsang shangs bzang spyan bar ldog / khri dang rgyan mdzes li dam ra srid pa tsam/ /rgyu 'du ldem gyi tshul du bzhugs pa'ang yod/ / pye brag bal po'i lha yin rtogs pa sla/ / sod la chos rgyal li ma snga khyi gsum/ / snga ma chos rgyal srong

btsan sgam po'i dus/ / zi khyim li dkar li dmar gtsang ma dang / / dkar dmar sho bsgrigs byas dang gser dngul dang / / shel dang rdo 'jim sogs la bsgrubs pa snye/ / zhal gyi dkyil 'khor khyon yangs sha nyams 'asol/ / zhal ras ltod smad rgyas zhum med pa la/ / cung zad dkyus ring shangs bzang spyan dkyus ring / / ma chu gos gtsang zhing tshugs legs sha nyams che/ / phyag zhabs mnyen zhing gos 'khyud chung ba ste/ / phal skad lug gdong shin tu mtshar ba 'du/ / snyo gyogs pa dang 'du ba'i pad gdan dang / / khri dang 'asol gdan ci yang med pa'ang srid/ / na bza' per dang zhabs la phyags gsol ba/ /dgra rgyan gsum pa rtse mo nang du tshab/ / phal cher na bza' ga grong ris yod pa mang / / chos rgyal sku la la thod na bza' ber/ / phyab/sa yod gzong ris can te tsha gser dang / / gyo rtse byugs sam ci yang ma byugs pa/ / ra gan khro las mib na 'du cog yin/ / bar pa mas rgyal khri srong lde btsan dus/ /gzhan rnams snga ma dag dang mtshungs pa las/ / zhal dkyus cung thung sor mo'i rgas mi gtsang / / gyo rtse byugs shing phra rnams tshon bkra bkye/ / gsham gyi lugs la cung zad mi gtsang zhing / / phal cher dgra rgyan gsum pa mang ba yin/ / chos rgyal sku la la sod med pa la/ / dngu sku lan ngu g.yas g.yon gnyis su 'phyang / / dngu rgyan gsum pas mdzes par brgyan pa yod/ / grang gser byugs dang ci yang ma byugs pa/ / phyi ma mnga' bdag khri ral dus su byung / / 'phags pa'i yul gyi bzo nyos bsgrubs pa'i lha/ / li dkar rtsod med las chib yul dngus kyi/ / lha dang rigs 'du khyad par 'gyed pa la/ /‘61

zhal ras cung cho 'gying bag bde cha che/ / dngul zangs spyan 'byed phrul du byung ba yod/ / zangs thang ma byung zangs mchu dngul spyan yin/ / ra gan las chib de las rgas mi gtsang / / li dmar la sa chib phyi ma dag dang mtshungs/ / chos li phyi ma zangs 'dres yod pa'i phyir/ / snga ma dag las rim pas smug pa yin/ / gyi ma 'di la tsha gser byugs pa nyid/ / bye brag lha btsun khu dgon rnam gnyis dus/ / zangs dmar zi khyim bsres la zhang zhung gser/ /'thug por byugs pa shang bzang sha tshugs rgyags/ / 'gying bag bde nyams bal pa'i lha 'du zhig / 'byung ba 'di la mthon mthing ma ru grags/ / hor la stod hor yu gur la sha dang / / chu nyo sī ta'i 'gram la yul 'di rnams greng chags su gnas pas so/ / slad hor rnam pa ba zhir dbye ltod hor la/ / dkar dmar 'dres pa'i khro li nag yo dang / / smug dang nag yo rgya rag las dkar tsam/ / stod hor lha ni zhal dkyus cung thung zhing / / sha tshugs tsho la zhal khyim zlum pa yin/ / rgyal yo hu la hu'i khrims bcas pa'i dus/ / na bza' sku la 'khril zhing gos 'khyud ring / / sul zhib chu yi gnyer ma dang mtshungs te/ /shangs spyan la sogs la che'i lha dang mtshungs/ / pad 'dab che zhing sul can cheg kyang la/ / ya pad ma pad ldan zhing sked nyag gam/ / dbyig ma 'dab mo sgug mo che ba'am/ / klu yis bteg pa'i khri stan yi bzhi 'am/ / zlum yo brag ri gdan du byas pa yod/ / bye brag yul der rgya nag rnying ma'i bzos khro li smug sar zhal ras khyon dog cing / / sha tshugs sdig la cung zad zhal sko kong / / spyan dang mchu gos chung zhing gos 'khyud gyi/ / lteb sul mang la khri stan rgya 62

yig dang / / rgya mi mchod rdzas gzong ris bris pa byung / / la che'i bzo bos li smug la sogs pa/ / bzos pa'i la che'i lha dang mtshungs pa'ang 'byung / /tsha gser byugs dang ci yang ma byugs pa/ / yu gyur yul du li dkar dngul dkar dang / / bsres pa'i dkar shas dngul gyi dbyibs 'du dang / / khro li sbug po dag las bsgrubs pa'i lha/ / zhal dkyus thung zhing zhal zlum shangs rgyud ran/ / cung zad brdal zhing sku tshogs shin tu 'thug / na bza' sku la 'khril zhing gos 'khyud nyung / / kri yi tshugs bzang 'gying bag cung zad kyang / / phyag zhabs sor mo cung zad skyos mi gtsang / / rgyan kyang ha cang mi mang cung zad 'gyig /phal cher pad gdan bzhugs khri med pa mang / / yod rnams stod hor lha dang mtshungs pa yin/ / la sha zhes pa le yul dag gi ming / / lha rigs chos li snga ma dag dang mtshungs/ / smad hor lha ni zhal ras smad rgyas shing / / bsam yas dge rgyas kyi lha dang g.yu ru khu 'grag gi lha rnams de nas phebs par bshad pas so/ /spyan dang mchu mas chung la zhal khung ldem/ / phyag zhabs gzhon sha chags shing sor mo thung / / na bza' sbub cing gos 'khyud cing zhib ran/ / khri dang brag ri'i steng du bzhugs pa mang / / khro li smug dang shing las byas/ / bye brag hor gyis rgya nag 'dzin pa'i dus/ / cong li dang ni de dang li dmar bsres/ / rgyal po go dan nas ye suska the mur gyi bar rgyal rabs drug gis 'dzin pa'i dus/ / tsha gser gyis byugs tshugs sogs rgya nag bzhin/ / tsan dan shi shing phal pa'i shing dang ni/ / shel rigs ma na ho dang g.yang kro'u sogs/ / rdo rigs dag las byas dang bse r+ha dang / / gser dngul zi khyim dag kyang srid pa yin/ / rgya nag rnying ma dang 63

ni gsar ma gnyis/ / rgya nag rnying ma'i lha rigs sha sbag cing / / shangs legs zhal kyong mchu sgros shin tu gtsang / / thang ce'u'i rgyal brgyud kyis 'dzin pa'i dus/ / zhal dkyus cung ring spyan ni phra ba dang / / na bza' dar dpyangs lhub la gos 'khyud gtsang / / rgyan spros mang zhing gtsang sha 'thon pa yod/ / phyag ni cung thung sor mo dod pa yin/ / 'ga' zhig lha dang rgyal yo'i dgyibs dod tsam / /zhal ras gzong gis brad tsam byas pa'ang 'byung / / rgyu ni khro li nag smug gnyis su nges/ / rgya nag gsar ma tshugs dang brad brdar gtsang / / li dkar dmar bsres pa'i ta ming rgyal brgyud gyis 'dzin pa'i dus/ / gser mdog legs la sha rgyags gos 'khyud legs/ / zhal ra sa cung leb spyan dkyus ring pa yin/ / pad+ma kha sbyar gnyis brtsegs rgyab mdun 'khor/ / yar mar rtse gnyis cung zad phyir gyed pa/ / gong 'og thu tig phra zhib bstar dkyus stoms/ /zhabs sdom legs shing rdo rje rgya gram spus/ / de la zho rtsi nges par byugs pa yin/ / bye brag cung zad gtsang sha chung ba dang / / rdo rje rgya gram mtshal dang yi ge med/ / sku rim mar grags rgyu ni rgya rag dang / / rag spya ci rigs 'byung ba rtogs par sla/ / rgya gar sangs rgyas byung sems sku nyid dar/ / sngags sku bla ma'i lku ni srid pa tsam/ / ci yang ma byug sa pa dang 'dzam klung gser/ /yi gar 'ong bar gsol ba ci rigs 'byung / / rgya nag gsar rnying hor sogs phal mo cher/ / sangs rgyas byang sems sku mang bla ma'i sku/ / re re tsam 'byung rgyal po'i kri yang srid/ / rgya gar shar phyogs dang ni rgya nag tu/ / sbungs sku shin tu dar bar byung ba yin/ / mchod rten lha babs rnam rgyal rgya gar las/ /(〉
