srid mtha' ma bkag tsam zhig sod da phebs/ / sod kyi pad spangs lcags te dag — me zhabs can/ / la mtshal byugs pa rtsa nyams rdzo so rje'i/ / phyag nas mar grags tshad ldan gtam las byung / / rna thos bskur min rtog dgyod mig zhib mos/ /brtags pas yid ches gnas su ces mi rung / / gsung rten hor shog 'gol mnyen khro ba gnyis/ / dang yo gla rtsi gan shog ces su grags/ / phyi ma hor gyi shog su phal pa ste/ / rgya gar shog gya phal ni mnyen pa mang / / gser la 'dzam gya chu bo'i gser bzang dang / / tshe ring bya yis zos pa'i gran gyi gser/ /dkar ser 'khrug pa gser gyi mchog tu bshad/ / de 'og gar log gser ni dmar ngams che/ / de las gzhan pa phal pa'i gser du 'dod/ / mon shog la sogs brtag par sla ba'i phyir/ / de dag las chib gsung rab chogs rnams ni/ / khyad par gos shog ces grags mnyen zhing 'jam/ / dmar kyi me tog zlum brtsegs ri mo can/ / be+eḍūr+ya yi zhun ma sngo kyis bris/ / be+eḍūr+ya yi glegs bam zhes grags so/ / de ltar rten brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa nyung ngu 'di/ / dge slong pad+ma dkar yos/ mkhyen brtse dgon yo tshe dbang kun mkhyen dang / mkhas skor ba rnal 'gyor nyams dga' sgo bde'i ched du bkod pa rdzogs so/ / / / —65

mche da cha sa kyi skor/ rang re'i sman rdzongs tsan dan g.yu lo rgyas pa'i rgyal lab 'di nang lo brgya phrag mang po'i sngon nas rang chas su yod pa'i tshos dang rig gzhung bzang po 'di nyid deng sang 'dzam gling yar 'thon can gyi rgyal lab gzhan la yang ngoms rin chog pa lta gya zhig gyur yod/ de yang sngon rgyal ba'i thung dang mkhas pa'i bstan bcos rnams nas byung ba ltar mchod chas sna tshogs pa'i sgra dbyungs snyan po'i sgo nas phyogs bcu'i zhing lams rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyon chogs 'dus pa bzhin du spyan spring ba'am thugs rgyud bskul ba'i brda dang thabs shes pi ma'o ba'i mtshad chas dang mtshad rdzas rnams bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod/ de rnams re re bzhin du dgos pa dang rgyu mtshan/ mtshan nyid dang phan yon/ grangs nges dang nges tshig sogs gsang sngags kyi cho ga spyi gzhung nas byung ba ltar rgyas par bshad pa la ha cang dgos ma'o ma mthong bas 'dir yongs su grags pa'i mchod chas ting dang / mtshad kong / 'or yug ma/ pad sder/ dung rgya gling / rol mo sil snyan/ pheb rdob gam po sangs/ rkang gling / rnga/ rdor dril/ cang te'u/ dung dkar/ 'khar rnga/ rdza rnga dzo rnga la gcig pa dang / la gnyis pa/ rnga/ rnga zlum/ rnga g.yog / khrir byugs/ theg chen gan dril/ sum pa/ gser skyems phyad spyogs/ min raka gi snod/ bdud rtsi'i thod pa/ dung mchod/ rigs lnga dar dpyang / maṇa ḍal/ gang gzar/ grags gzar/ dug chas dang

zor chas sogs mdor na zhi rgyas/ dbang dug sogs kyi las rab 'byams la ma'o ba'i ca chas rnams mtshan gyi rkang grangs tsam 'dir 'khod par byed pa yin/de yang mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog / bdug sgos/ mar me/ dri chab/zhal zas sogs mtshad rdzas rnam dag 'gyal ba'i snod ni gser dngul zangs li rag sogs las sbub pa'i mchod ting bdun tshar gcig dang / khyad par du dro ga rgyas spros sogs la nye bar mkho ba'i mchod ting brgya tshar dang stong tshar sogs rang so'i dgon sde dang grwa tshang lag gi rgyu lto sa dang bstun pa'i mtshad ting gi grangs mang nyung dang rgyu bzang ngan ci rigs las tshib pa sna tshogs yod/ mchod ting gi bzo dbyibs dang rin thang can ni mchod ting bzo mkhan gyi mkhas pa'i lag tsal dang / rgyu bzang ngan/ gsar rnying / sa gnas so so'i 'byung khungs sogs kyi khyad par las mchod ting g.yag mig ma dang / mthil 'angur ma/ zhabs can ma/ spros rkos can ma/'a jam sang ma/ zi ling ma sogs dang / gzhan yang lto 'grag las byung ba'i snyo ting /rgod dngus gtsang ru bzhi las byung ba'i bod ting / bal po'i bzo bo las byung ba'i bal po'i ting / rgya dkar nag las byung ba'i rgya ting sogs bzo rnam mi 'du ba du ma yod/de yang mchod ting g.yag mig ma zhes pa ni ting gi bzo dbyibs dud 'akro g.yag gi mig pa dang 'du bas na mchod ting g.yag mig ma zer ba yin/ mchod ting mthil 'gyar ma ni ting gi mthil zhabs nas yar nang du cung zad 'thur du 67

dod pa rnams la mchod ting mthil 'gyar ma zer ba yin/ mchod ting zhabs can ma ni ting gi zhabs ring dang ldan pas zhabs 'og 'og stong can la mchod ting zhabs can ma zer ba yin/ mtshod ting spros rkos can ma ni mchod ting gi spros rkos ri mo sna tshogs can dang / khyad par du pad+ma'i rkos ris can la mchod ting spros rkos can ma zer ba yin/ mchod ting zi ling ma ni sa gnas zi ling gi phyogs nas thon pa dang ting gi mthil zhabs su dung dkar gyi ri mos mtshan pa la zer ba yin/ zi ling gi mchod ting 'di rnams tsa che shos rtsis mthong byed pa yin/ mchod ting 'jam sang ma ni spros rkos sogs gyi ri mo gang yang med pas rgyu legs zhan ci rigs la sa chib pa la zer ba yin/ mdor na gong du mchod pa'i ting gi ming dang bzo dbyibs rgyu legs zhan sogs re re bzhin du 'dir smos kyis mi lang / 'on kyang rten gsum yig tshang gi khra mo'i nang du 'khod pa'i mchod ting yod rigs rnams dkon gnyer/rdzong dpon/ bskang rgyun pa rnams rang so'i ngos nas ca chas gang yin gyi ngos 'dzin mthil phyin par byas te rtsis len rtsis spyod kyi skabs pi thugs rig gting nas sgrim dgos zhes nang ma'i sprin bskul du zhu ba yin/mtshod kong la yang mtshad kong khor yug ma zhes che 'bring chung gsum dang /mchod kong nyin mtshan thub pa/ skal bzang mchod kong / bal bzo'i mchod kong /ting cung rka nga med ma/ lha sa rkang can ma sogs bzo rnam dang rgyu legs zhan ci rigs las sbub pa yod/ mchod kong khor yug ma la bzo dbyibs kyi khyad par las khor yug dril gzugs ma dang / sgong gzugs ma zhes rnam pa gnyis su yod/ de yang 68

che 'bring chung gsum gyi dbang du byas na rnam pa gsum yod/ mchod ting khor yug ma che shos gcig gis mar me zla grangs mang po gnas grub pa yin/ lor yug dril gzugs ma dang sgong gzugs ma zhes pa ni sngon mkhas yib gong ma rnams gyis bzo rig lag tsal can dag la dril gya dang tshang nga'i dbyibs la dper blangs te bzo spyin byed du bcug pa la brten nas mchod kong lor yug gi ming la yang dril gzugs ma dang sgong gzugs ma zhes tha snyad yongs su grags pa yin/ mchod kong nyin mtshan thub pa la yang rkos ris pami can dang / bkris rtags ba rgyad sogs kyis brgyan pa ci rigs yod/ khyad par du mtshad kong 'di rnams kyi mthil zhabs su pad+ma'i 'thur dod can dang 'jam sang ma sogs rnam pa mi 'du ba sna chogs yod/ gzhan yang dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i 'go tsam na rgyal ba bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho'i skabs su bzos pa'i mchod kong la skal bzang mtshod kong zer ba yin/ skal bzang mtshad kong 'di la yang rgyu bzang ngan dang bzo rnam legs zhan ci rigs sna tshogs yod/ bal bzo ba rnams kyis zangs ser shas che ba las bzos bskrun byas pa'i mchod kong la bal bzo'i mchod kong zhes zer ba yin/mar me brgya mtshod 'thul rgyu'i kong thu la yang rgya bod dang bal po sogs las byung ba'i ting cung rkang med ma dang / lha sa rkang can ma sogs che chung dang bzo rnam mi 'du ba sna tshogs yod/gsum pa gtor ma dang tshogs mchod sogs gang la yang nye bar ma'o ba'i mchod chas snod gzhong la yang ji skad du/ gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba'i snodaḥ dpal 69

shos dkar mngar bdud rtsi lngaḥ zhes pa ltar rgyu rin po che gser dngul zangs lcags sogs las tshib pa'i pad sder la yang che chung dang / lnga tshar/ bdun tshar/ bcu tsha ra sogs grangs nges med sna tshogs yod/ spyir pad sder zhes pa ni/ nye nyon 'khor ba'i spyon gyis ma gos pa'i brdar rab dkar pad+ma'i gdan la kun 'dus rin chen 'bar ba'i gtor ma dang chogs kyi 'khor lo ga ṇa tsa kra sogs ci yang bzhengs 'gyal byed du rung bas na pad sder zhes spyi ming bye brag la btags pa yin/ pad sder gyi mtha' 'khor thams cad pad+ma'i 'gyar du dod pa dang / lebs su grags pa 'di rnams la pad sder pami can zhes zer ba yin/ spros rkos yod med gang yin yang pad sder gyi zhabs su yu ring dang bcas pa rnams la pad sder zhabs can ma zer ba yin/ gzhan yang zangs dmar ser dang / dngul dkar sogs kyis bzos bskrun byas pa rnams la zangs thebs dang / dngul thebs zhes pad sder chung ba'i rigs la zer ba yin/bzhi pa dung dang rgya gling sogs kyis mtshon pa'i sgra dbyungs sna tshogasi kyis mchod pa'i mchod chas rigs la yang tshogs dung / dung chen/ bod dung / rgya gling /rkang gling / mi rkang / rgya rkang / dgra rkang / zangs rkang sogs rgyu dngos sna chogs las chib pa yod/ de bzhin thabs shes zung gi rdor dril la yang rtse dmi ma dang / rtse lnga ma/ dril thu chu thigs ma/ theg chen gaṇa 〉la sogs dang / gzhan yang thod dem/ting shag / shangs sil/ rdza rnga 'khar rnga 'thur rnga lebs rnga rnga so che rnge'u chung / bod kyi rnga sgor can ma de rnams kyi rnga g.yog gam rnga 'degs dang khrir byugs sogs rgyu bzang ngan ci rigs las yib pa dang / che chung nges med sna tshogs yod/ 70

dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab gyas kyi skabs su dril thu bzos bskrun byas pa rnams la lto dril zhes 'gangs can rtsis pa yin/ dril thu chu thigs ma zhes pa ni dril su'i gsham du rdo rje chung ngus bskor ba'i steng 'og tu chu thigs dang 'du ba'i ril thu chung ngu re 'thur du yod pa la dril thu chu thigs ma zhes pa 'di ni shin tu 'gangs can yin/ de yang rang re lto 'grug lta ngu la ja dril dang chos dril sogs gyi tha snyad dril ngu che 'bring sna tshogs yod/spyir mchon byed rtags kyi rdo rje la yang rtse gcig pa dang / rtse gsum pa/rtse lnga ma/ rtse dgu ma/ rtse mo stong gi bar du yod/ she gis mu spri las/ rtse dgu rtse mo gcig pa dang / / rtse lnga rtse mo gsum pa can/ / de ltar la sogs dril ngu che/ / rtse mo stong gi bar du'o/ / zhes gsungs/ rdo rje rtse dgu ma la ming gzhan ye shes rdo rje zhes byu ba yin/ gzhung las/ rtse dmi zhes ni bya ba yis/ / ye shes rdo rjes 'gro ba sgrol/ /zhes dang rdo rje rtse lnga pa la dam tshig rdo rje zhes pa yi na/ dril ngu la yang sa gnas kyi dbang du byas na hor dril / rgya dril/ rgya nag gi dril ngu/ sod chen dril ngu bcas bzhi tsam yod/ dril thu'i rgyu ni li dkar dang li dam ra dzigi sogs rgyu sna tshogs las tshib pa yod/ hor dril la dril thu shing kun pa dang phal pa zhes rnam pa gnyis yod/ rgya nag gi dril ngu la khyad dril dang / phal pa/ hā ming bcas rnam pa gsum yod/ rgya nag gi khyad dril rtse lnga pa rnams chu srin gyi la nang du bstan pa dang / rtse dgu pa rnams tse pa tu'i rkos ris dang ldan pa yod/ rgya nag gi rgyal po hā ming gi skabs su bzos pa'i dril gya la hā ming ma zhes zer ba yin/ dril thu 'ga' zhig la laji'i 71

yi ge yod / theg chen gan dril ni shin hu che ba dang / dga' ldan gan dril ni de bas cung zad chung tsam yod/ da ba dru chas rnams gyi dril gya bskor ba gang zhig la/lha mo brgyad gyi sa bon tā dang pad+ma sogs gyis mtshan pa la rdo rje sems dpa' ye shes kyi dril gya zhes pa yin/ lha mo brgyad kyi sa bon med pa rnams dpa' bo'i dril thu zhes bya/ shar du 'khor lo/ lto ra rin chen/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gri sogs kyis mtshan pa yod na rigs so so'i de bzhin gshegs pa ngos 'dzin gyi sgo nas dril ngu'i ming yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i dril gya zhes bya ba yin no/ / cang te'u la yang rgyu tsan dan dkar dmar dang thod pa sogs las yib pa yod/ de ni zheng du chung tshad sor brgyad dang che tshad sor bcu gnyis gyi bar bzos pa'i khyad rnam mi 'du ba che chung gsum tsam yod/ de yang rdo rje phyar pa'i rgyud las/ mi thod tsan dan shing rnams las/ / sor brgyad bcu'am bcu gnyis dang / / sor dmi sor mo bcu gnyis tshad/ /ces rgya cher gsungs so/ /lnga pa rol mo dang sil snyan sogs la ji skad du/ rnga chen dung dang rdza rnga pa ṭa ha/ / sil snyan phebs rdog la sogs rol mo'i tshogs/ / zhes byung ba ltar rol mo la yang stod gangs can rdzongs nas thon pa'i god rol/ rgya dkar nag las thon pa'i rgya rol/ bod yul gra phyogs nas thon pa'i gra rol bal yul bzo rig lang nas thon pa'i bal rol/ hor nas byung ba'i rol mo sbubs can ma/gnyer nas bton pa'i gter rol byin rten ma/ gzhan yang lho 'byug yongs la grags pa'i pheb rdog po sangs bcas nang gses gyis rol mo'i rgyu bzang ngan 72

dang / che chung / gsar rnying / legs zhan sogs rnam grangs du ma yod/ rol mo de dag gi nang nas 'gangs can rin thang dang bral ba ni gter rol gyin rten ma 'o na yin/ sil snyan la yang rgya sil/ 'grag sil/ go sil/ hor sil/ sil snyan snu nga ma dang sil snyan rigs lnga ma bcas nang gses gyi dbye ba du ma yod/sil snyan hū nga ma ni sil snyan sbubs 'ong gi nang du rgyal kun thugs kyi sa ston yi ge hū gis mtshan pa la sil snyan hū nga ma zhes tsa che shos rtsis pa yin/ sil snyan rigs lnga ma ni sil snyan sbubs 'ong gi nang du rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sa gon oṃ snu su ā hā bcas yod pa la sil snyan rigs lnga ma zhes zer ba yin/de yang hor sil la hor dza lanar pa rnams gyis bzos pa'i sil snyan thod rgya che la 'khor rgya chung tsam yod pa dang / skad snyan la rgyang grags dang ldan pas sil snyan dza lanar pa zer ba yin/ hor shing kun pa rnams kyis bzos pa'i sil snyan thod rgya chung la/ mdog ser mdangs can yod pas sil snyan shing kun pa zer ba yin/ hor spya so mkhar du bzos pa'i sil snyan la ra thod dang sbal thod sprel sod sogs thod dbyibs mi 'du ba sna tshogs yod/ rgya sil rnams hor sil dag las snyan cha chung ba dang / sgal thod kyi nang du thugs rje chen po'i gzungs sngags ma ṇi dang lalngi'i yi ges kyang mtshan pa yod pas rgya sil ma ṇi ma zhes zer ba yin/ de bzhin rol mo la yang hor rol la nang gses mi 'du ba gsum tsam yod pas/ hor rol rnams tho rjes mngon par gsal ba dang thod khyim cung zad rol mo gzhan dag las che la 'khor rgya chung ba yod/ mdog kyang ser nag dang sngo nag sogs rang bzhin 73

gyis tshib ste yod/ rgya rol dang bal rol phal che ba thod khyim cung zad chung ba dang 'khor rgya che la/ mdog kyang sngo spya dang g.ya' mdangs gser zhag can sngo nag sogs blta na sdug pa yod pas skad snyan 'khrol zhing rgyang grags che ba yod/drug pa maṇa khel la yang gling bzhi spros rkos can ma/ spros can g.yu phra ma/maṇa ḍal bkris rtags brgyad ma/ 'jam sang ma/ maṇa ḍal tshom thu lnga pa sogs mu tig gi lcags ri tog dang bcas pa yod/ maṇa shel gyi snod gzhong la yang li sder dang 'khar gzhong / zangs dmar ser dang dngul dkar sogs las bskrun pa'i snod gzhong sogs ci rigs rnam pa sna tshogs yod pas/ khra ma 'god mkhan rang so'i ngos nas cha dpag ste mkhyen dgos/gna' snga mo'i dus su mtshad lang dang / tshogs lang / 'du khang / sgong khang sogs rgan mes mtshan mo gsal bar byed pa'i snod la wang sogs kyang khra ma'i nang du 'khod yod rigs ngos 'dzin byu shes pa dgos/ de bzhin du chu skyes me tog 'dam sum̐ sogs kyang yul lung so so nas 'thon bskyed byung ba'i bzo rnam dang che chung 'du min sna tshogs yod/ gzhan yang thum pa dang gser skyems tshad spyogs/ sman raka gi snod/ dung mchod/ thod pa/ rigs lnga dar dpyang sogs k+to ga spyi 'gros la ma'o ba'i mchod chas rnams kyi ming grangs dang gal chen sogs rlo por don spya shar ba tsam ma yin par mchod chas 'di rigs kyi rgyu bzang ngan gyi dbye ba dang / rin thang che chung /gsar rnying sogs la dgyod pas nyams chod pa/ mthong bas ngos 'dzin pa/ rig pas 74

brtag shes pa sogs nges par du rang gzhan kun la tshang dgos/bdun pa mnan sreg 'phang gsum gyi las rab 'byums sogs sgrub pa la nye bar ma'o ba'i dug chas dang zor chas/ gzhan yang lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags shog/dril gya bcas bzhi dang / gang gzar grags gzar sogs mdor na rdo rje slob dasan la nye bar ma'o ba'i thur pa dang g.yab dar yan chad kyang rten gsum yig tshang gi khra ma'i nang du ji ltar 'khod pa bzhin du brda dang tha snyad gyi ming sogs dngos spyad gang dang gang la btags pa rnams kyang mchod chas nu rigs 'di dang 'di yin gyi ngos 'dzin ma nor ba'i sgo nas rang so'i dgon sde dang grwa tshang gi khra ma'i nang du'ang zhib gsal tshul mthun 'khod dgos pa'i thugs dgongs dbyings nas mnga' ba 'tshal/mkhan yo thun chogs bkris/rgyal yongs dpe mcha yig tshang /gong gi mtshad cha rnams spya 'gyung sgrungs gsham gas ltar yin/1 kun mkhyen 'jigs gleng gi dgongs 'dus rnam bshad/'a rin chen brtag pa'i gtam/ tsirta ma ṇi'i mdzod lang /75

3 rdo rje phyar pa'i rgyud gyi to ta ma 'thum sde/4 she ki mu spri/pa 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos dpyad don gsal ba'i rgan me yid bzhin gyi nor gya /6 rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyi rnam thar legs bris 'dod pa'i re skong /

mtshad rdzas snye rnam bshad mdor bsdus/oṃ swa sti spros pa'i mtshan ma nyer zhi tshos kyi kri/ / 'gag med cir yang 'char ba longs spyod rdzogs/ / gang 'dul sna chogs don mdzad sprul sku ste/ / sku gsum bdag nyid dpal ldan 'grag par 'dud/ / rab 'byums rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zhing gi rgyan/ / yid 'ong lha rdzas las tshib mchod pa'i rdzas/ / de yi brda don rnam par bzhag pa'i gtam/ / nying du'i ngag gi lam nas smra bar spro/ /zhes mchod par brdzod cing btsam pa dam bca' ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'i me tog 'thor nas gang zhig gleng bar bya ba ni 'dir 'dus shing chogs pa'i lhan rgyas yongs la chos srid thugs gnyis kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i gnas rdzong gzhis lag dang gtsug lag khang rnams su bzhugs pa'i mchod rdzas kyi rnam bshad mdor bsdus tsam zhu rgyu ste/de yang mtshad rdzas zhes pa ston pa thugs rje can gyis rang cag slob pa lam du zhugs pa rnams la bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'i thabs yan lag bdun du gsungs pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ yan lag gnyis pa mchod pa phrul ba'i yan lag las 'gos pa zhig yin phyir thog mar mchod pa'i rnam gzhag mdo tsam zhu na dang po mthun mong theg pa'i lugs la dngos su 'gyor ba'i mchod pa/ yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa/ smon lam stobs kyi mchod pa/ bla na med pa'i mchod pa/ bstod pa dbyungs kyi mchod pa dang bcas lnga yod/ de yang dngos 'gyor gyi mchod pa lta thu zhig la cha mtshon na spyod 'jug las/ rin chen sems 'di bzung bar byu ba'i phyir/ / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos/ / dkon mtshog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas sras/ /77

yon tan rgya mcho rnams la legs par mchod/ / ces gsungs pas/ bsam pa dag pa/zhing dag pa/ dngos po dag pa bcas dag pa gsum gyi mtshan nying/ dang ldan pa zhig nges par dgos/ gnyis pa sto min sngags kyi theg pa'i lugs la phyi mtshod nang mchod gsang mchod dug lnga'i mtshod pa dug gsum gyi mchod pa phyag rgya bzhi'i mchod pa la sogs pa'i dbye ba mang des na gyi nang snod bcud mchod pa'i sprin zhes gsungs pas rnal 'gyor lta dgongs dang ldan pa'i ngor snang srid 'khor 'das kyi tshos so cog thams cad mchod rdzas kyi rang bzhin du ma gyur pa gcig kyang med pas na mchod rdzas zhes pa'i tshig don 'di nyid ha cang gis khyab chen yo zhig lags/'on kyang rang cag 'jig rten tha snyad grags pa'i dbang du byas na gtsug lag lang la sogs pa'i rten gzhal yas lang mdzes par pyed pa'i rgyan gyi rnam par gnas pa nang gi bla bre/ de'i mtha' bskor gyi gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan spyan gzigs dar dpyangs sogs rgyu dar zab dang gos chen sogs las byas pa la mchod rdzas zhes pa'i tha snyad kyi rnam gzhag yod/de ni rte na zhal yas lang gi dkyil 'khor dang brten pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor zhes rten dang brten pa'i tshul du gsungs kyang don la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams spangs rtogs mthar phyin te gang du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshe ye shes rang snang gi bkod pa de nyid la gzhal yas khang zhes btags pa tsam ma gtogs sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs chos nyid kyi yon tan las logs su gyur pa'i rdzas tshib kyi gzhal yas khang zhig ni yod par mi sems te/ snying thig las/ brda don rtags gsum yongs 78

rdzogs pa'i ཿ phyi nang zangs thal chen po'i dgyasaḥ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/de yang gdul bya'i re ba skong ba'i brdar gzhal yas khang gi rgyu rin yo che las tshib pa/ thugs chos nyid kun tu mi mnyam pa med pa med pa'i brdar dpyibs lnga bzhi pa/ye shes bzhi'i brdar nang gi sgo bzhi'i phyogs mdog can/ tshad med bzhi'i brdar phyi'i sgo bzhi la sogs pa gzhag yod do/de bzhin du gzhal yas khang gi phyi dang nang rnams su mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan gyi rnam par gnas pa'i chos rdzas rnams la'ang brda don yang dag pa dang ldan pa zhig ste ji ltar zhe na tshos nyid rnam par dag pa'i brdar bla bre/ thugs rjes 'aspo kun skyob pa'i brdar rin po che'i gdugs/ snying rje chen pos kun la khyab pa'i brdar ba dan/bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i brdar rgyal mtshan zhes gsungs pas so/gdul bya thun mong gi dbang du byas na gdugs ni rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i dathu la mchod pa'i mtshad rdzas shig hu 'dod de/ spyod 'jug las/ rin chen gdugs mchog gser gyi yu ba can/ / khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ongs ldan/ / dpyibs legs blta na sdug pa sgyeng ba yang / / rtag tu grub dbang rnams la dngul bar bgyi/ /zhes gsungs/ mtshod rdzas de nyid kyi srol dus nam las byung ba'i tshul yang mdo las/sngon bdag cag gi ston pa la g.yas nas lha tshangs pas baiḍūr+ya'i gdugs brgya phrul ba dang g.yon nas brgya spyan gyis 'dzam ngu'i chu gser gyi gdugs brgya phrul ba dang zhes pa'i lo rgyus las rtogs nus so/de nas bzung ste 'dzam gya gling du mtshod rdzas gdugs kyi srol bzang yo de nyid byung bar brten 'grag sman rdzongs rgyal lab 'dir yang bla chen dang rten 'gangs can gyi 79

rigs la gdugs kyi mtshad pa 'gyal srol yod pa ma tshad de nyid gal chen dang mnangs chen zhig tu brtsi mus yod/rgyal mtshan ni pha rol mi mthun g.yul las rgyal ba'i brda rtags shig yin phyir rten gsum khyin can bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang dang thugs gnyis 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rdzong gzhis lag tsho'i gser tog gi tshab dang de tsho'i mdun la lha dar 'phya ra tshe tog gi tshul du'ang bkod srol yod/ deng sang yongs grags bsdus pa'i khugs la phyed 'phyar /rgyal mtshan/ 'phen bcas cha re byas pa la mtshad rdzas cha tshang zhes brdzod srol yod pa bzhin 'phyed 'tshar ni gdugs kyi yan lag dang / 'phen ni ba dan gyi yan lag yin nam snyam/ mchod rdzas gyi yan lag gzhan yang / ka ba'i rgyan la ka 'phen/ gdung gi lebs la gdung khebs/ gyang logs kyi yol le/ mchod khri'i stegs khebs/ khri lebs/ rgyab yol la sogs pa mang du yod/spyan gzigs dar dpyangs zhes pa ni/ gzhal yas lang mdzes byed gyi 'phyang 'phrul rgyan gyi khyad par zhig yin par nges te/ spyod 'jug las/ gzhal med yo brang bstod dbyungs yid 'ongs ldan/ / mu tig rin chen rgyan 'phyang mdzes 'bar ba/ / dpag bsam nam mkha'i rgyan gyur de dag kyang / / thugs rje'i rang bzhin can la dngul bar bgyi/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ de yang spyan gzigs la rgyu'i dbye ba gser dngul zangs lcags dang dar gos sogs kyang byas srol yod/ dar dpyangs ni spyir btang tsam las rgyu'i dbye ba de tsam med/ spyan gzigs steng gi ri mo yang zhi ba'i rigs la ri mo me tog sogs dang khro so'i rigs la ri mo mi mgo thod skam sogs 'god pa'i khyad par dang de khar dar dpyangs gnyis kyi dngus su dar sna lnga'i chun yo la g.yas g.yon gnyis 80

la da ra rtse dkar ra dang spyan gzigs kyi rtse spud mtshams rnams su'ang dar dpyangs thung du re brgyan srol 'dug /sku rten na bza' ni/ spyir btang lha so so'i sku mdog dang mag pa gzhir bcas dros sku dang chags bral gyi rnam pa can la chos gos rnam gsum dang / longs sku chags bcas kyi rnam pa can la dar gyi chas gos lnga gsol dgos nges kyang / sku gzugs ris su bris pa/ 'gyar du dod pa/ lugs su blugs pa gang yin kyang na bza' de dag tshul tsam rang chas su mnga' bas phyi nas na bza' phrul skabs rgyas pa'i dbang du byas na long sku'i rigs la sku stod nas rdor gong dang sku smad nas slad dkris kyi tshul du gdong khebs re phrul srol 'dug gzhan spyir btang chos longs sprul gsum gang yin kyang gong 'ja' ris sna lnga ma'i na bza' kyang pa re ma gtogs rgan srol med/ de las lha bzhengs bzhugs kyi rigs la ni smad dkris gdong khebs dang stod g.yog gi tshul du dar dpyangs dang 'du ba'i na bza' re 'gyal srol yod/sangs rgyas gnyis pa o rgyan yi ru rin po che ni gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog gi rdo rje slob dpon yin pas na kun mkhyen 'jigs bral gling pas/ theg gsum rdzogs pa'i brda rtags suḥ yod la chos gos ber mdung ma nabs bas ཿces gsungs pa ltar nyan thos gyi theg pa rdzogs pa'i brdar chos gos dang / byung sems gyi theg pa rdzogs pa'i brdar per mdung zhes zla gam dang / gsang sngags kyi theg pa rdzogs pa'i brdar phod la ste/ go rim ni nang nas chos gos dang phyi nas phod la de'i phyi nas per mdung mnabs pa'o/ 81

9 1 rten dang a6sdu da thos spya gos chen snang pha man na de dpye ba zhi/ 1 rgya nag gos che rgya ser ni gser skud las byas pa/ de rnying pa la lar gser ngo ma yang yod/'a spud thag ni 'tshem 'grab dang 'du ba'i ri mo mthug po yod pa/3 rgyan gzhi ni me tog sna chogs pa mtha' nas gser skud kyis ma bskor ba/4 cod ldan ni shing lo'i ri mo can mtha' nas gser skud kyis bskor ba/pa 'ja' ris can ma ni gzhi dang mdog mtshungs kyi ri mo can g.yung grang lag ris lta ngu/6 'jam sang ma ni 'ja' ris kyi rna ma pa tsam yang med pa ste/ 'ol chod tsam du dpye ba drug tsam yod/ 'a gos rigs spya dgye ba zhi /1 stag ser nga 'du zhes pa seng ge dang 'grug gi ri mo can/'a 'grag 'khor zer ba dngus 'khor lo'i mtha' nas 'grag la 'thab kyis bskor ba/ de la 'grag ris can ma zer yang lab srol yod/mi dar masdu tshod 〈mi dgye ba sna/nya nang mdzod nyin mo bde legs ni ring thung gi tshad bkab ni dang 'a spri mnyam 'ong /'a bar mdzod ni gzhi dang ri mo gong mtshungs dang ring 'thung de'i phyed tsam/3 dar rtse ni ring thung mda' dar gyi tshad dang mnyam pa 'dom ko tsam/4 min rtse ni gzhi ser po'i steng mar ljang gi khra can no/ 82

gzhan gos chen gos gsar dang dar gsar bzo 'du mi 'du sna tshogs yul dus dang bstun te 'thon pa'i rigs ni cha 'du ba tsam re ma gtogs de dang 'di zer ba'i nges pa can gyi rnam gzhag ma mthong ngo/lha ra bzhis pa/'dir 'bad legs byas cha srid na/ / bstan pa spyi dang sgrub brgyud mtshog /rnyed dang bkur sti bcas gnas te/ / 'gro kun rdzogs byung thob par shog /zhes pa'ang 'grag gzhung bca' rnying 'dzin spyong 'go dpon nas gsungs bskul bzhin shing khyi zla tshes dge bar rdzong la gong 'phel lhan tshogs kyi rtsom sgrig pa'i ming tsam 'dzin pa thum thang pa snye 5 pa'am yongs grags chos spyong du 'bod pa des gang dun tsam zhig bris te phrul ba'o/83

thang ka dang sdeb ri skor gas bshad/ da res rang re'i 'byug rgyal lab nang gi sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang mchod chas mchod rdzas sogs khra mar 'god de bdag 'dzin gces spus byu dgos pa ni rgyal lab rang thugs kyi ca rnying nor gya rin po che dang 'du ba de dag 'thor yar mi byung ba'i ched du bdag 'jin 'thab dgos pa'i gnad dang bstun go bsdur zhal 'dzoms kyi slob spyong 'go dang pa zhig 'go tshugs gnang ba dang 'brel lha bris ri mo'i byung khungs dang ri mo dar tshul gyi rim pa bcas mdor bsdus te cung zad zhig gsal bshad zhu ba de yang / sangs rgyas phal po che'i mdo las/ sems ni ri mo mkhan dang 'du/ / sems kyi yung yos byas pa te/ / 'jig rten lams ni ji snyed pa/ /de dag sems gyi ris mo yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar kun rtog bzo gos byas pa'i cesas kyi rnam grangs la mtha' gtugs pa med pa las re zhig bsdu na/ lag gi 'a du byed kyi 'gral las bskrun pa sogs byed pa yo dang 'a brel ba'i thus kyi bzo dang /sgra dang snyan ngag 'i dbyungs sogs brdzod pa sgra'i rigs su gtogs pa ngag gi bzo dang / 'khor 'das kyi chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam par bzhag pa la sogs yid kyi bzo ste gsum du bsdu ba las 'dir lus bzo'i 'ongs su gtogs shing / de la'ang gtso phal gnyis las 'dir gtso so rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bzo'i khongs su gtogs/ de la ris su bris pa dang 'thur du dod pa sogs yod pa las ris su bris pa'i thog ma 'dzam thu gling 'di —nyid la ji ltar byung ba ni/ sngon mi rnams tshe lo 'gram thub pa bri la nye ba'i dus mi'i rgyal po 'jig thul zhes bya ba zhig byung / des sa gzhi chos bzhin du baspyangs pas slar tshe lo 'gyam du 'phel nas 'jig rten rnams bde zhing spyod par gyur/ rgyal pos bka' thub chen po 84

spyad pas dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad thob/ tshangs pas lha'i mtshon gyis kyang mi phigs pa dang bstan bcos thams cad shes pa'i mchog srin/ de'i dus su bram ze zhig la ngu zhig yod pa shi ba las bram zes rgyal por chab 'bangs la 'di ltar dus min gyi 'chi ba byung ba rgyal po khyod gyis rgyal srid chos bzhin ma baspyangs pas lan pa 'du ste/ gal srid gya bdag la slar gson por ma thob na nga nyid rgyal po khyed kyi spyan snga 'di na lceb bo byas pas/ rgyal pos bram ze khrid de gshin rje'i rgyal yo nyi ma ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba'i grangadu brtol nas bram ze 'di pa'i thu slar gnang du zhu zhes nan gyis gsol/ der gshin rje rgyal yos bdag gis ma lan rang rang gis las su zad do zhes smreng bas rgyal yo khros de g.yul bshams nas lha'i mtshon gyis gshin rje'i 'khor rnams pham par byas/mthar gshin rjes dbyug pa dang / rgyal pos dbyug pa tshang mgo can sogs te 'thab pas 'jig rten thams cad dngangs par gyur pa na tshangs pa gyon nas sems can rang nyid kyi las su zad kyi sa gshin rjes ma nyes/ 'on te bram ze'i ngu yi gzugs kyi rnam pa ji ltar mchis pa ri mor bris shig ces bshad pas rgyal pos de ltar bris nas tshangs pa la gtad/ tshangs pas bsgos pa bzhin slar rgyal pos gshin rje la phyag dang mchod pa byas pas kun dga' bar gyur/ yi dwags la gcer thu zer ba de rgyal yos btul bas rgyal po la gcer thul dang / ri mo dang por 'bri ba po yin pas dang po 'bri ba po zhes kyang btags/ slar rgyal pos tshangs pa'i gan sa su phyin nas ri mo 'bri tshul zhus pas tshangs pas ri yi mchog nas ri rab yin/ / sgong nga las kyi rnams kyi ni/ / gtso bo nam mkha' 85

lding yi no/ / mi yi gtso bo sa bdag ste/ / de bzhin ri zo sgyu tsal gtso/ / sogs dang / rgyal yo de bzhin sgyu rtsal kun/ / ri mo'i las la yang dag brten/ / zhes sogs kyis bsngags nas bzo nyo bi sha kurmas ston par 'gyur bar khung bstan/ji ltar tshangs pas lung bstan pa bzhin du phyis bi sha /mis 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha tshad gtso bor byas nas tshad dang mi ldan pa la nyes pa dang / tshad dang ldan pa la phan yon ji ltar thob pa'i lo rgyus bshad cing / de yang cha tshad can tsam du ma zad lus la mdzes pa ma tshang na/ / tshad dag gis ni ci zhig bya/ / zhes ri mo'i rnam 'gyur sogs kyang mdzes dgos par bstan ces grags so/ / de las sku rten bris sku'i dar tshul la snga ba ni sngon ston pa zhal bzhugs pa'i dus su sang khyer sgra rgog gi rgyal yo u spri ya na dang ma lha lha'i rgyal yo gzugs can snying sto gnyis re zhig gnas kyis bskal pas ma mthong yang sems kyis brtse ba'i mdza' bshes su gyur te phan tshun yi ge 'grol ba las dus lan cig gi tshe u du ya nas rin thang bral ba'i yan lag lnga ldan gyi go cha zhig rgyal po gzugs can snying po la skyes su bskur/ gzugs snying yos ri mo mkhan zhig stos de lton pa'i sku dngos la dpe bgyid nas 92bri bar btsams pa na sku'i gzi byin gyis sri bar ma nus pa la ston pa chu rdzing gi 'gram du bzhugs su gsol nas chu nang sku brnyan shar ba la dpe blangs nas ras la bris te u spri ya na la bskur ba de snga bar grags pa dang / yang ston pa ser kyi'i gnas su chos gsung nas bzhugs pa'i dus su shākya'i gya mo gzhon nu mdzes ma lang cho dang ldan pa rin po che'i rgyan gyis spus pa zhig kyang chos zhu ba'i gral du 'khod kyang / sems la rang gi rgyan cha bzang 86

ba'i khengs dregs skyes te chos don la mi bsam par 'dug pa'i khengs pa 'gog phyir shākya'i ming chen gyi khyim thab zla 'od mas rang gi g.yog mo ro hi ta la rin po che do shal len du btang ba na/ ro haṃ ta mas nyan 'go bcad de 'gro dgos pa'i sems pham dang bcas 'khro ba'i lam du/ ba zhig be'u gsar du skyes pa zhig dang 'phrad de be'u la chags pas ro haṃ ta brdungs te chos don sems la dun bzhin shi ba de'i skye ba rjes mar siṅga la yi rgyal po'i gya mo mu tig 'khri shing du skyes pa'i dus po brang gi phyi la mnyan yod kyi chong pa rnams tho rengs sangs rgyas kyi chos tshi ga khru ru blangs pa thos pa nas thu tig 'khri shing dga' ba tshad med skyes te tshong pa'i lag tu sangs rgyas la zhu yig dang skyes bzang po phrul btang naba'i lan du sangs rgyas sku gzugs ras la bris te bskur dgos par bi sha kurma la bskul bas/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gzi brjid kyis tshad 'jal ma nus te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ras kyi rgyab tu bzhugs nas ras la sku gzugs ji lta ba'i 'od btang ste 'od ji ltar 'dug pa brir bcug pa'i 'og tu kyibs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi lnga/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi don la sogs pa bris nas siṅga la'i rgyal por bskur/ rgyas pos kri thang dpyangs pa'i tshe mu tig 'khri shing dad pa'i sbu long g.yos shing mi ring bar bsam gtan rgyu la spyo sa nas byung chub gyi go 'phang thob pa snye de dag ras bris thog mar byung ba ste rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dathus su dar ba de ri mo bri rgyun shin tu gtsang dag yin par bshad/dedag gi rjes su 'brangs nas rgya stod kun tu dar zhing dus gyis ldeb ris dang thang ka mthong grol shog thang tshems grabs thags sku tsakli la sogs pa byung 87

ba'o/ / 'thur sku'i thog ma ni khyim bdag dad srin gyis bcom ldan 'das gyi dge 'dun rnams rang gi khyim du gdugs chod la spyan dungs pa'i tshe ston pa ma gyon tshe gral gyi thog ma mi brjid par mthong nas khyim bdag mgon med zas spyin gyis ston pa'i 'du sku bgyid du chog par gsol bas gnang ste rasna'i rigs sna phyogs kyi rgyu las byas pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs par grags pa dang / ston pa lha gnas su yum la chos ston par gshegs pa'i shul na gsal ldan gyi rgyal glon rnams kyi dad rten sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan bzhengs su 'dod pa'i tshe mo'u gal gyi thus rdzu 'phrul la brten nas bzo so dang lhan cig lha gnas su sangs rgyas gyi sku'i dbyibs ji ltar rlor nges par byas nas sang khyer gsal ldan du slar log snye lku rgyu tsan dan las yib pa'i ston pa'i snang brnyan phyag g.yas spyabs spyinadang g.yon mchog spyin gyi phyag rgya can bzhengs stabs su bzhugs pa zhig bzhengs par grags pa dang / de bzhin sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gyis ma 'ongs pa na bdag nyid ma mthong ba'i spyo so dag gi chogs gsog pa dang dge 'dun 'dus pa'i rten dang bdud dang thu stegs pa zil gyis gnon pa dang bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'i phyir sku tshab bzhengs shig ces 'phags pa 'jam dpal la bka' gnang ba ltar/ lha'i dbang yo brgya byin gyis rin po che sna lnga bcu tsa gcig sbungs te bzo bi sha gami la sangs rgyas kyi sku tshad gsum bzhengs su bcug pas dming lo brgyad pa dang bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad rim pa bzhin du pang du 'tsho ba'i ma ma dang rgyan 'dogs pa'i ma ma las dpe len cing dgung lo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'i sku tshad lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis sum cu rtsa gsum du spyan springs/ gzhan gnyis 'jig 88

rten mi yul gyi 'gro don du bzhugs par grags pa ni sku rten gyi thog ma yin lags/ sku rten de dag las sangs rgyas dgung lo brgyad pa'i tshad can ni rgya gar rgyal yo snyerma pa la'i dus bal po'i rgyal yo dharma a shas gdan 'dren zhus te bal por bzhugs pa dang / dming lo bcu gnyis pa'i tshad can ni rgya gar gyi rgyal po go sngal zhes byu ba'i skabs su kri stegs kyi dmag dgrang mang po 'ongs pa ma grub par dmag rgyab rgya nag rgyal sto las 'tshol te thu stegs kyi dmag las rgyal ba'i dga' tshor du rgya nag rgyal po'i skyes su bskur dgos pa byung ste kri de rgya nag tu lo lnga brgya bzhugs te 'khro don mdzad/ de rjes sod sprul pa'i chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mo rgya bza' gdan 'dren skabs kyis mo'i rten skal du zhus te da lta bod lha sar bzhugs pa'i jo so shākya mu ne+e ste/ de dang dus mtshungs shākya mu ne+e la dpe blangs te bzhengs pa'i rdzo so'i sku rten rang re 'grag tu yod pa ni spa bro skyer chu dang thum thang byams pa lha khang du bzhugs pa'i rdzo rgo shākya mu zhe'i kri rten rnam gnyis te de gnyis ni byin rlabs lha sa'i rdzo so dang dbyer med par grags shing 'grag yul du kri rten thog ma yang yin pas sku rten de dag la dpe byas te dus gyis rin yo che dang sa rdo shing la sogs par 'thur du dod pa dang lugs su grags pa spros brko ba la sogs pa ji snyed pa'i sku rten rnams te 'grag tu sku rten thog mar dus rabs bdun par rdzo rgo rnam gnyis la 'khor byung sems nye sras kyis bskor ba rnams dang /gnyis par dus rabs brgyad par mi ru rin yo che 'i zhal bkod bzhin bzhengs pa ni rten gtso rnam par snang mdzad 'khor du rigs lnga'i lha tshogs yod pa sum thang rtse khung dang dge ldan stangs a nu lha khang rnams su bzhugs pa dag yin par grags so/89

sangs rgyas gnyis pa slob dasan chen yo pami 'byung gnas kyi sku rten sog ma ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni thang yig las/ mi ru rin yo che rgya gar nas bod du gyon te 'od du dgung lo 55bzhugs nas lto nub srin yul du gyon ran lar rgyal sras mu tig btsan yos yi ru nyid bod du mi bzhugs par srin yul du cis kyang 'gyon na sku tshab gcig bzhag dgos par zhu ba bzhin mi ru 'du ma'i sku brnyan bzhings te bsam yas su bzhugs su gsol zhing tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen yo bskor ba'i dus dming mo dbang gis dus su tshogs kyi 'du ba la rgya gar nas mkha' 'gro ma man dha ra wa de nyid gyad med sngon mo dar gyi yang rag gsol ba zhig gi chas su gyon te slob dpon chen po'i sku tshab la bstod pa mdzad cing / man snye ra was siṅga la'i gling nas bye ma a krong dang slob dayon chen po'i shangs khrag brdzis te zhabs la srin yo'i thod pa tshal thu sbyar ba lnga bzhengs pa de la sku tshab gter lnga mar zhu ba ste o rgyan rin po che'i rang gis phyag bzo yin par grags pa dang / de dag mi ru'i sku brnyan mi yul du bzhengs pa'i thog ma ste/ dus kyis yi ru sgrub thabs rnams dang 'khril te yi ru mtshan brgyad bsam lhun lha bcu gsum bar chad lam sel lha bcu gcig la sogs pa'i rten byung ba rnams yin lags/ de ltar gong du bshad par ltar ston pa'i sku tshab lha da bang brgya byin gyis bzhengs pa'i dming lo nyer lnga'i tshad can de las ras kyi bkab nas spar du len pa'i bris rgyun de rgya gar nas bal yul du dar zhing bal yul rtsogs nas 'od du dar khyab che ba las de'i bris rgyun de 'jam dbyungs sprul pa rgya nag hu 'khrungs pa'i phyag bris rgya nag si thang chen mo dang sod kyi lha bris pa rdo ba bkra rgyal la slob ma slob dpon rang las mkhas pa gnyis kyis rgya nag si thang rgya bris mdzad mkhan spyo ba ni snyo brag sman thang 90

nas 'khrungs pa'i bla ma gong dkar stod mkhyen brtse'i gris rgyun sman grags dang mkhyen bris gnyis su dar ba dang / yang gtsang stod nas sprul sku byi'u chung pa zhes gangs rdzongs su lha legs pa'i tshad ldan gyi snyan grags rgyas shing na bza'i sul nyung bas sku sha ma bsgrib pa spros pa nyung zhing mdangs kyi mdzes cha ston pa ni gong dkar mkhyen brtse chen sto'i lugs su bshad/ sman gsar tshos dbyings rgya mtsho'i thugs mtsho las lho brag sprul sku nor gya rgya mcho dang / e yul nas mdzes ma spyod/ rkong yo bla ma smin gling chos bzang sogs kyis dar khyab byung ngo / / de nas zhabs drung rin yo che lto'i gdul byu dus la babs te gyon pa'i dus su 'ja ma dbyungs dpal ldan rgya mtsho'i bris rgyun las dar ba sprul sku 'byug pa bstan 'dzin dang / gdung mkhar slob dpon mkhas pa dang la gling slob bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal dang a sang nor thu don chib las brgyud pa dang 'grag gzhung grwa tshang nang dge drug gi dus su spre'u byung chub sems dpa' zer lha bris phyag tsal mkhas pa bla na med pa zhig byung ba las lha bris dar khyab che bar mdzad 'dug /yang de'i rjes su lha bris byung chub sems dpa'i yang srid gcig gyon nas lha bris bzo rgyun dar khyab mdzad pas byung chub sems dpa' gnyis par grags shing de'i lha gris slob ma mtsha mas brag dgon par slob dpon lhag pa rdo rje dang de'i mched glogs bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal dang dar dkar tshe dbang rdo rje mang sde nas slob dasan shākya rdo rje dang 'khan nas slob dpon gangs chen mang sde nas slob dpon rtsis mi'am chos nyid lhun tshib slob dpon smon lam rab bzang thum thang lha bris pa ta'u takru kun bzang mala' glong bla ma ko ta shar phyogs sbum ma'i rtse slob dpon gsang sngags rdo rje de'i slob ma tshe dbang bkra shis gcen mkhar slob dpon phyar rgyal mang sde slob dpon shākya rdo rje'i slob ma slob dngon thur rgyal gyi thu gcen mkhar slob dayon rig 'dzin 91

nor thu de'i slob ma mong sgar srungs bca' la o rgyan tshe ring de'i slob ma dugos sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin gong du lha slob rig 'dzin nor su'i slob ma phran gcen mkhar pa o rgyan lhun srubasogs da lta 'grag rgyal lab nang lha bzo'i ri mo dar khyab byung ba ji snyed bcas kyi lo rgyus mdo tsam nu ba dang 'grel phran pa o rgyan lhun sbub rang gis bzhengs pa'i lha bzo yang rgyal yum sku bsres pho tshogs chos skyon gis phyan tshogs gling lha lang gsar bzhengs nang sku yi tshon dang kyang bris stod pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis/ rta mgor bskyed tshog rdo rje phreng ba'i dpyir 'khor cha tshang bkris sgang bkang lung shes rab rtse lha khang gi logs ris yi ru mtshan brgyad dang bla brgyud/wang si si lha khang gi sdeb ris mdzod pa bcu gnyis/ bde chen chos gling ge sar lha lang 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal yo sogs dgra lha'i sdeb ris/ srungs/ thang 'du khang chen mor 'jam dbyangs lha lang dang bde mchog lha khang gi kyang bris 'jam dpal mtshan brdzod gyi lha tshogs dang bde mchog lha chogs sum thang sku rjes su bka' dgongs phyar gsum gyi lha khang gsar par o rgyan rnam thar sin dhu rgya mtsho'i byang ris/ thim phya bkris chos rdzong nang dpal ye shes kyi lha mo gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs gris thang nyer gcig / 'grag gi rdzong gzhi rnams la'ang gos sku mthong krol chen mo gu ru mtshan brgyad dang zhabs drung tshan sum tshogs pa'i 'khrungs rabs bcas kyi ri mo'i btsag dpar/ bkris chos rdzong dge 'dun kun dga' ra ba'i steng thog kyang ris ston pa'i mdzad bcu/ dgongs rdzogs mchod rten nang bka' brgyad dang o rgyan rje 'bangs nyer lnga bar chad lam sel lha bcu gcig/ bsam pa lhun sbub lha bcu gsum/ spyabs rje bdud 'ardzoms rin po che'i sku phreng bcas/ da lta'ang srungs thang ma chen gzims 92

chung gsar pa'i skyang bris zhabs drung sku phreng rnams dngayi dam rgyud sde bzhi 'i lha tshogs bcas gzhung gi bka' rgya ltar phyag gyid zhus dang zhu yus bcas yin la/de yang ri mo kun gyi 'bri tshul la'ang 'di ltar/ bcad la mdud pa med pa rta rnga brgyangs pa 'du/ / tshon la byug ris med pa la ba babs pa 'du/ / mdangs la gad pa med pa me long has btab 'du/ / spyon dang pad+ma'i rigs la yal so ring na legs/ /lag len ldan pas bcad la malas par byed/ / ngang ring mdangs mkhas 'jam zhing legs par byed/ / sbyangs pa che bas tshugs la malas par byed/ / shes pa can gyi gzugs brnyan rta glang sogs/ / me ris pa tā bzo sna'i rig byed kun/ / brtson 'khrus che bas las rnams myur du 'chib/ / zhes so/ri mo rnams la gzab pa'i gnas su byed/ / bzo sor bkur zhing bltod na gzab pa'i gnas/ / mkhas pa 'gran gyi pyed na zab pa'i gnas/ / des na 'bad nas brtson 'khrus bskyed par byu/ / g.yo sgyu spangs shing rang gis gang shes gzab/ / tshad ldan phan yon tshad med nyes dmigs bsam/ / kun la lhag bsam phan pa'i sems ldan na/ /dkor la rnam smin chung zhing phan yon thob/ / nyin re bzhin du lha sku bris bzhengs kyis/ /dge tshogs ma gyur 'akro la bsngo shes na/ / mi ring byang chub thob par smre tshom med/ /de pyir sems bsnyed bsdo smon rgyas gdab bya/ / 'dir 'bad rnam pa dkar ba'i dge chogs kyi/ / bzo bo spyin bdag 'grel thogs gtso byas pa'i/ / mkha' khyab sems can mngon par sangs rgyas shog / ces ri mo 'bri tshul las gsungs yod/93

lha de ltar bris pa'i phan yon yang khung gyi 'chib pa'i tshul/ bslab btus las/mi brjed 'jig rten gyi lams kyi sems can thams ca da la 'dod yon lnga'i spyan pa byin pa las/ dge bsnyen gcig la'o/ de dag thams cad las ni dge slong gcig la'o/ de dag thams cad las ni rdo rje 'dzin pa la'o/de thams cad bsnyen bkur ba las ni sku gzugs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa mtshon gang ba gcig bzhengs na bsod nams khyad par du 'phags so/bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ sngags pa las ni dang po pas/ / gzugs brnyan la sogs bya ba ste/ / bris sku sgrubs na myur ba ni/ / dngos tshib rgya chen thob pa gyur/ / zhes dang / sngon tshe 'das pa'i dus na ni/ / dmangs ri thu ni dpa' bas byed/ / ri mo mkhan du gyur pa'i tshe/ / mtshan nyid ldan pa'i ri mo'i tshogs/ / rtag tu 'bri bar brtson ldan pas/ /nam zhig ma sogs 'khro rnams la/ / cesas bstan rgyal ba'i zhing lams su/ / nam mkha' la ni sangs rgyas so/ /ra lhas che bar gsungs pa ni/mkhas pa gang gi 'jibyed pa/ / de yi bsod nams mtha' yas gyur/ / bskal ba bye ba byas pa yis/ / sdig pa shin tu mi zad pa/ / sa steng ri mo mthong ba tsam/ / de yi tshos la 'byung bar byed/ / 'tshams med lnga po byus pa dang / / tshul khrims nyams dang dman pa dang / / sdig pa kun la 'jug pa dang / / 'khor lo'i yi pa spyod pa dang / / 'kho ba'i skyes gnas ngan pa dag / der ni ras bris bzhag mi bya/ / ras bris mthong ba don ldan 94

zhes/ / thub pa'i dbang pos gsungs pa yin/ / mthong ba tsam gyis dga' 'gyur te/ /de bas skad cig de tsam gyis/ / yid ngag lus ni dag 'jug dang / / rjes su bzlas pa gyed pa dang / / sngags rten nyid la rtag brtson pas/ / mi rnams yib thob smos ci dgos/ /bskal pa pye ba sangs rgyas la/ / mchod pa'i bsod nams gang yin pa/ / sa snyeng ras bris 'bri ba yi/ / bsngags pas bsod nams de thob 'gyur/ / gaṅga yi ni bye ma dag /rang rgyal dang ni byung chub sems/ / bse ru nyan thos 'jig rten na/ / lan mang dag tu mchod rten byas/ / ras bris mthong ba tsam gyis ni/ / mi yi de bzhin bsod nams thob/ /ces so mdor na dam chos pad dkar las/ / gang zhig bcigs ngos sku gzugs ri mo dag / bsod nams rgyal mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku/ / bdag gis bris sam 'bri ru bcug kyang rung / / de dag thams cad byung chub thob par gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa dang /skyes gya gang gis 'on te gzhon nu rung / / gang dag la la de na bslab pa'i tshe/ / rtsedamo dag dang dga' ba byed pa na/ / rtsig 'os sen mo'am shing thus gzugs bris pa/ / de dag thams cad byang chub thob 'gyur te/ / zhes dang /gyis pa'i rtsed mo de dang de dag tu/ / gang gis rgyal ba de phyir mchod rten gang / /pye ma las ni phyang por byas pa yang / / de rnams gyis kyang byung chub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pas bde legs su 'dod pa dag gis mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i ska gzags bzhengs pa la brtson pa ches thang she ba95

du byed pa rigs so/lha bzo'i mtshan nyid ni/ lha bris byang chub sems dpa'i phyag rgyun las/ / lha bris zhes pa'i phyag srol de nas spel / de yang rgyal ba'i bstan pa ni rgyal ba nyid kyi sku gzugs kyi phrin las dang bcas pa 'dzin pa yin cing / de la sku'i mig rten zhig med na tshul ji ltar sgom mi shes pa'i phyir dang / mchog ༅ mong gi dngos yib thob pa la bskyed rims kyi dmigs pa gsal bar dgos la/ sku brnyan mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig ci nas kyang dgos te/ / lha'i mtshan nyid brtag thabs sogs chos dang mthun par dpyad byu la/ rgyal ba'i sku gzugs spyon bral yon tan kun ldan zhig dgos te/ gun sa'i rnams kyi sug ris la yid ches pa'i phyag rgyar ma yin pa phyir blo dang ldan pa dag gi tshad mar byu ba gnas ma yin no/ / bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ kos ko mgrin pa byin pa ste/ /snyan dang shangs nyams spyan g.yo ba/ / mchu dang zhal gong khur chos dang / / 'gram pa brang dang rtsibs logs dang / / nu ma mchan dang dpral ba dang / / phyag sor zhabs sor mi ldan pa/ / ha cang ring phra sgom pa dang / / spyon rnams lhams te ma spang na/ / gnas las nyams shing bskud par 'gyur/ / dngos sib 'joms dang dpal g.yang nyams/ / dgra dang bgegs 'byung choms kun gyis/ / sdug bsngal myong zhing 'chi bar 'gyur/ / de lta su'i skyon rnams dang ma bral ba'i gun po'i migaci lam du mdzes pa la lhur blangs bar mi bya'o/ /zhi ba la ni zhi ba'i zhal/ / khro bo la ni 'jigs pa'i zhal/ / sgeg pa la ni bzhad pa'i zhal/ /gris sku sgrub nas myur du ni/ / dngos yib rgya chen thob par 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa dang / /rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las/ bzo so ma mnyes pa'i lha la ye shes pa mi 'jug cing rab

gnas kyi thog mar bzo so mnyes par byu/ zhes dang / mi g.yo ba'i rgyud las/ bris rgyu tshad ldan yongs su zin nas bris mkhan la ji ltar 'dod pa'i yod phab pa bzhin byed par byu 'o/ /ji skad du/ dad mdun brtson 'chis snying rje ldan/ / dge la mngon rgyo gtong 'od can/ /brtan cing ngang ring g.yo sgyu med/ / lha dang bzo so la yisapa'o/ / zhes pa ltar lha bzo mkhan yo bshes gnyen bsnyen pa mdo dang bstan bcos rnams las ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin bkur sti wun sum chogs pas mnyes par byed pa'i spyin bdag gi yon tan de dag dang ldan dgos la/ / rgyun bdag gi skyon ni/ sdig la mi 'dzems dad 'dun chung / /tshe 'dir blo 'dod grags 'dod che/ / ngang thung theg chung 'gyod sems can/ / las rnams 'gror bzhag the choms che/ / lha dang bzo bo dmod pa'o/ / zhes pa ltar/ bzo rgo la sun chung ba ni lha sun phyung ba yin par bshad pas/ / de ltar bzo yon gnyis spyon kun spangs shing yon tan dang ldan dgos so/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod nams 'od zer gyi lha bzo'i spyon ni/ lha bzo mkhan po ltar snang ni/ / yon tan mi mkhas 'dug mi tshugs/ /sogs pa mi bde chang la gtsi/ / cung zad byin na skyon pa 'du/ / mayi dka' zhe khengs shin tu che/ / za 'dod mchu rno 'dod pa che/ / yon brgyags la sogs thang med 'bebs/ /des kyang ma tshim rgyu rnams brku/ / rnyed pas rang gzhan sdig pa spel/ / yon bdag dad pa dbang med ldog / de yi 'bras gya ngan song gsum/ / de 'du mi bstan rgyang du spang / /zhes dang / sam bhu ṭi las lha bzo'i mtshan nyid ni/ / dul zhing tshul ldan lang tsho bab/ /dbang po gsal zhing rnam rtog med/ / khro med slog 'phyas mi byed cing / / shin tu mkhas la spro ba che/ / bzod ldan snying rje che ba'o/ / 97

gris pa yo rang nyid lhag bsam ldan zhing dkon mchog gsum la kyibs su bzung ba'i rnal 'gyor gyi/ / ras gzhi sogs yum dang / lag cha sogs kyang las kyi lhar bskyed pa nges par dgos so/ / spyin bdag gi mtshan nyid ni/ / phan yon yid che shes rab ldan/ /'gyur med spro zhing brtson 'chis che/ / dka' dpyad bzod sran ngag tshig 'jam/ / dad yis che zhing tshul khrims can/ / phang med gtong yod dge la spro/ / rim gyi dga' ba sgom pa'o/ / zhes gsungs pa dang /e ma/ kun dang mi mthun med pa rgyal ba'i sku/ / mkhas pa spyan lam dag la ma mdzes na/ /thig tshad ldan par slob pa gad mo'i gnas/ / zhib tshugs legs par spyangs pa ma nus shing / / lha tshogs 'bri dang bzhengs rgyu'i khur len pa/ / rang spyon gzhan chong mkhas pa'i mdun du zad/ / de bas brtags dpyad legs par ma/bas pa dang / / ri mo 'gran gyi spyangs na gzab pa'i gnas/ / sku mdog phyag mtshan 'gyings stabs la sogs pa/ / so so'i mngon rtogs gzhung dang mthun par 'thad/ / zhes so/lha bzo'i mtshan nyid ni/ g.yo sgyu spangs shing gang shes gzab/ / tshad ldan pha na yon nyes dmigs bsam/ / kun la lhag bsam phan pa'i sems/ / rnam smin chung zhing phan yon thob/ / nyin re lha kri bris bzhengs kyis/ / dge chogs ma gyur 'aspo la bsngo/ /byung chub thob pa the chom med/ / sems baspyod bsngo smon rgyas gdab nas/ / rnam par dkar ba'i dge tshogs gyis/ / bzo spyin 'grel thogs gtsor byas pa'i/ / thams cad mngon par sangs rgyas shog / ces gsungs pa bzhin gong du smos pa'i lus bzo dang 98

ngag bzo yid bzo gsum las/ / 'dir lus bzo la gtso phal gnyis las gtso go dkon mchog gsum gyi sku gsung thugs gyi rten bzhengs rnams so/ / spyir gyi lha khang mjal ba dang tshon sogs la blta bar byed pa'i tshul yang 'di ltar mkhas pa zhib dang tshugs la blta bar byed/ / gun yos bkrag dang 'od la blta bar byed/ / gyis pas byu dang shing la blta bar byed/ / de nas bzo rgo mkhas pa rang gi ni/ / rlo yis dpyad nas legs par 'bri bar byu/ / lha bzo mkhan ji ltar nyes gyur kyang / / bde ba can gyi rma byu spyo bar 'gyur/ / skyes nas sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtse bar byed/ / tshon tsam byugs par shes pas der skye na/ / cha tshad ldan pa'i sku gzugs 'bri ba ni/ / lha dang mi ru skye ba smos ci dgos/ / mthong thos sprin reg bsod nams tshad med pas/ / de bzhin gshegs pa'i kri gzugs 'gri la brtson/ / sangs rgyas sku gzugs bzhengs pa'i mkhas pa des/ / spyin bdag nyams chung 'gyor pa med na yang / / rgyal ba'i sku ni bzhengs par 'dod pa yis/ /yid la yod na lha bzo dag gis ni/ / bstan la phan phyir yis pas 'gri bar byu/ / longs spyod ldan yang spyod par mi nus shing / / rgyal ba'i sku la rin thang med mod kyang / / de yi lag nas bskul ba'i longs su spyod/ / ces dang / 'phags pa sdud pa las/ dper na ri mo'i las ni yongs zin mig med par/ / ji srid mig ma bris par brngan pa mi thob bzhin/ /de la mig bris nas ni rngan pa byed par byu/ / ces gsungs pa bzhin thugs la dgongs par mdzod/ / tshon gyi rim pa la'ang skam rlon gyi mdangs gnyis su dbye ba'i tshul yang 'di ltar/skam mdangs rlon mdangs gnyis yod pa las dang po skam mdangs ni/ sa gzhi nam mkha' la mthing shun mthing kyi sla mo lan grangs mang po rgyab dgos pa dang / sa gzhi la'ang pang shun sla mos de bzhin no/ me tog 'od 'khor lo sprin pad+ma sogs la tshon so so'i thob lam

dang bstun nas snyoms yor spya so'i rigs byugs pa dang rang rang tshon gyi la zhag gi mdangs chu'i mdangs rgyab pa la skam mdangs has mdangs zer ba thengs mang sa rgyab pa'i mdangs bltas dus snum cha che ba tshe sra ba chus kyang 'gyogs po mi 'jigs pa yin la/gnyis pa rlon mdangs ni dang yo nam mkha' la mthing bar 'tsho dang spya 'o gnyis dus mnyam byugs pas phan tshun 'dres te mdangs rgyab pa la rlon mdangs zer/ sa gzhi la yang pang cho dang kyi nyo gnyis mdangs de bzhin no/ / me tog pad+ma 'od 'khor sogs spya cho gnyis gyi mdangs rlon mdangs zer/ blta dus bkrag che ba legs shing / da lta rang re rnams rlon mdangs 'o nar dar srol che ba lags pas de dag gi sku rten bris sku'i 'byung khungs dang phan yon ri mo'i cha tshad spyon dang nyes dmigs tshon mdangs kyi rim pa bcas mdo tsam sngon gyi lo rgyus spyir btang la gzhir bzhag rang rlos gang shes tsam zhig gsal bshad nus chib pa bcas /bkris bde legs/o rgyan lhun chib/lha bris slob dpon/100

tshan spyor skor gsal bshad/ srol 'dzin ca rnying 'dzin spyong sde tshan nas 'grag gi lha khang dgon sde'i khra ma bzhengs rgyu dang rtsis sprod kyi skor go bsdur zhal 'dzoms 'di nang 'gyon mi yongs la 'gyon pa legs so mdor bsdus te zhu ba dang 'brel tshon spyor lag len dang sa tshon btsags te tshon btang thang sogs gsal bshad zhu ba de yang / rang re'i sman rdzongs dpal ldan 'grag pa'i rgyal khab 'di nang lha bris byung chub sems dpa' zhes malas pa dpag tu med pa gcig gyon 'dug 'ong gis bzhengs pa'i lha de rnams la la zhig gsung gyon la la'i spyan chab shor ba la sogs rtags mtshan khyad par can mang yo yang byung ba'i lo rgyus 'dug/ de yi rjes su yang lha bris byung chub sems dpa'i yang srid gcig gyon te lha bris dar khyab che bar mdzad 'dug / de'i slob ma mtshams brag dgon pa lhag pa rdo rje dang bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal sogs mang yo gyon 'dug pa dang de las slob rgyun rim par brgyud de slob dpon smon lam rab bzang mkha' klong bla ma ko ta sbram rtse slob dpon gsang sngags rdo rje de'i slob ma tshe dbang bkris gcen mkhar phyar rgyal mang sde shākya rdo rje de'i slob ma gcen mkhar rig 'dzin nor thu de'i slob ma mongs sgar sprungs ca la slob dngon o rgyan tshe ring dang gcen mkhar o rgyan lhun chib o rgyan tshe ring gi slob ma phran pa mongs sgar sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin dang 'dre sgongs dpa' go rdo rje o rgyan bstan 'dzin bcas spyo lo 196'anas 'dir gzhung du 'ong nas dkyil slob byu mdangs dang mnyam du lha bris las ka byus te da tshun gyi bar du gzhung gi bka' ji gnang phyag gyid zhus te yod/ ras gzhi bzo thang dang tshon spyor btang gi skor yang sngon gyi slob dngon lha bris pa mkhas pa rnams gyis zhal rgyun las gsungs pa'i phyag dpe bshus pa 'a di lta ra/ de nas ras kyi 'dul spyor bya ba ni/ / ka sha'i ras gtsang chu la dkrus 101

nas skam/ / skud pas mtha' brtsems rgyang shing tshad ldan la/ / ya yod gyogs mthon med pa snyoms pa ru/ / legs par kyang la grur bzhi lhag par 'thon/ / de nas chang zhim shin tu gar ba la / / spyin chu dri med 'dres nas legs par byugs/ / skam nas ka rag rgyab mdun gnyis ka la/ / spyin thag ran pa'i tshad ni mardzo zho tsam/ / til mig med cing srab la stoms par byugs/ / ka rag 'thug na zhal thang phrug mi brtan/ / de nas skam thag yongs su tshad pa dang / / glegs shing des 'jam steng bzhag chu gtsang ma/ / cung zad re byugs de nas gzi yis ur/ / chu ches pas ni sa btsag shing la'ang spyar/ / des nas ngan tsam phyugs pa lag len yin/ / ngos gcig skam nas ngos gcig ur ba ste/ / lan grangs gnyis sam gsum du ur dgos kyang / / shog thu'i skad 'don bkab bshus 'pher dgos dang / / dpe ri gris na skam ur byu mi dgos/ / zhal thang rgyab la skam ur byed na legs/ / la las sol ris bde ba'i khyad rtsis nas/ / ka rag sla mo byug pa'i khugs kyang yod/ / / / de nas mtshon gyi spyor sdebs bshad pa la/ / ram dang ka rag bsres pa sbyang mthing la/ / mang nyung khyed nu spya dang che ba yin/ / ram dang bab la bsres pa sbyar ljang ste/ / mang nyung khyed kyi ljang ser ljang nag shar/ / sngo spya'i steng du ram gyi khu ba grags/ /de yang spyar mthing gong las cung zad legs/ / spang sku'i steng du ram dang zhung khu gnyis/ /cung zad ri grags sbyar ljang byung ba yin/ / ka rag mtshal kun bsres pas dmar kyi ste/ /legs tshad ku ku ra tsa'i lce ltar mtho/ / rgya chos ka rag bsres pa na ro ste/ / legs tshad bsres ma'i me tog lta thu'o/ / yung ba tshad dkar spyar bas sdong rol te/ / ka rag zhung khan sbyar bas bab la'o/ / li khri spang gnyis bsres pa ja la ste/ / li khri bab la sngo sangs gsum 'dres pa/ / ja la cung zad nag pa byung ba yin/ / sngo sangs na rol 'dres pa mchen 102

la ste/ /de la mtshal gyis la thud cung zad bsre/ /zi hun zhes byu'i tshon du brjod pa yin/ /na ros la mdog cung zad smug pa la/ / ram gyi khu ba cung zad blugs pa na/ / de yang mchen la dag tu byung bar bshad/ / bab la'i steng du li shun cung zad gugs/ / de la snag tsha in tsam blugs pa yang / / ja la zhes su brdzod pa'i mdog byung zhing / / bab la'i steng du mtshal gyis la thun grags/ / li rdzus zhes byu'i dud kha shar ba yin/ / bab la'i steng du li khri cung zad grags/ / li sor zhes brjod tse rngi rnams wa ma'o/ / ja 'a lī spya 'dres 5 sbu 'a zhes/ /ri dgas rnams la nye bar ma'o ba yin/ / ka rag sngo si 'dres par bab pa ni/ / cung zad grags pa 'o la zhes su brdzod/ / sprir rtse tshon kong bkrus pa'i khu ba rnams/ / gcig tu bsags pa mtha' bsdu zhes sku brdzod/ / bug ri dud sgrin sogs la ma'o ba yin/ / ka rag steng du li shun cung zad blugs/ / mi sha ser nyams yod pa'i mdog tu byung / / ka rag mtshal gyi kha thun cung zad bsres/ / mi sha dkar ba'i mdog tu 'byung ba yin/ / de steng bab la cung zad grags pa yi/ / mi sha ser ba'i mdog tu 'byung ba ste/ / de la sngo kyi cung zhig grags pa yis/ / mi sha sngo ba'i mdog tu 'byung ba yin/ / de la snag tsha cung zad blugs pa ni/ / mi sha nag sa'i mdog hu shes par byu/ / btsag dang rgya tshos bsres pa btsan 'du zhes/ / tsan dan smug yo mod tu shes par byu/ / sha la dkar ba'i steng du smug po ni/ / cung zad blugs pa sha la smug po yin/ / de ltar tshon gyi spyor sde sna tshogs pa/ / mtheb sen steng du cung re spyor la blta/ / thams cad rig pa'i 'phrul du shes par gyis/ / 'byug pa'i tshon sa btsag dang sa nag sa ser ngang pa sa ka ra bcas kyi shing tshon dang thang ka ldeb ris la sogs pa tshon spyor te btang thang dang tshon spyor gyi rim pa la gsal zhu na/ de yang sngon bod nas thon pa'i bod tshon lta gya deng sang gi rgya chon de mdog 103

gtan yo zhig med brten nam phyag brtan pa'i ched du 'grag rgyal gsum pa'i bka' rgya bzhin 'grag gi sa tshon gyis lag len bya thang skor/ thog mar sa tshon rnams brko ba nas shing gi gzhong pa lta thur snod nang ras btsag legs par byu dgos/ de yang shing tshon btang rgyu la ras btsag thengs gcig dang thang ka ldeb ris la sogs pa'i tshon la ras btsag thengs gsum bzhi tsam re byu dgos/ mthing gi tshab hu tshon sa nag dang mtshal gyi tshab sa btsags ser yo bab la'i tshab ngang pa ljang khu'i tshab sa nag dang ngang pa spyor bas ljang khu dang de dag la sa ka ra grags te dmar spya dang ljang kyi sngo spya li khri mdog bcas sgyur dgos pa yin/ ram mdangs zhun mdangs rgya mchos mdangs bcas pa yang rdo ram btul zhing zhun mas ram mdangs dang rgya spyogs thab tu brtso zhing mchil ma chu phyir 'bo zhing khu ba ras btsag rgyab thab tu gar ba'i rgya mtsho'i mdangs dang zim shing ngam spang rtse shing gi lo 'dab skam yo thab la btso zhing lo ma phyir 'bo zhing khu ba gar ba'i chu zhun mdangs dang / tshon mdog dmar po'i rigs la ri mo dang na bza' sha bcad rgya skyegs kyi khu ba btang rgyu sngon po dang ljang khu'i ri mo dang na bza' sha bcad la rdo ram gyi khu ba btang dgos pa bcas/ pir dang phag ze la sogs pa de ngas rgya gar nas gang bas legs pa thon mus yod pa las sngar gyi lugs srol ltar bzo dgos pa'ang min 'dug /rgya grogs nas thon pa de la lag len 'thab mus yod/ tshon rtsi yang sngar srol yin na ko spyan btang thus yod deng sang rgya phyogs nas thon pa'i phe bi gal yang tshon rtsi byas btang mus yod/ nam phyag tshon gzhi yang de nyid brtan par 'dug de ltar btang dgos pa yang mi dbang mnga' zhabs nas chon rtsi ko spyan dri ma can ma yin par dri ma med pa'i 104
tshon rtsi gzhan 'tshol te btang dgos pa'i bka' rgya bzhin tshon rtsi gzhan btang thabs ma rnyed phe bi gal 'di btang thus yod pa bcas/sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin/lha bri rig mnyam 'a/la mdo chen/105

rgyal cangs dpe mtshad spyo skor dang sheng spar snye ma rgyus mdor bsdus/'grag gzhung rgyal yongs dpe mdzod gtsug lag khang 'di nang bzhugs yod pa'i rgyal ba'i gsung rab ga de sbre yod pa'i skor dang spar shing lo rgyus spar shing mi nyams par bzhag ni'i don khu ga de sge 'bad dgos pa'i skor mdor bsdus cig zhu ba cin dang pa rang dpe mdzod 'di nang khu rgyal ba'i gsung rab sde snod gsum tsam min pa lton pa bla na ma mchis pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya grub pa'i sku brnyan gyi gtsos pa'i sangs rgyas byung sems bla sku bcas sku dang de gshegs mchod rten brgyad kyi thugs rten bcas sku gsung thugs kyi rten cha tshang bzhugs pa thu brten dpe mdzod gtsug lag lang zer mtshan thu gsol ba yin/rgyal yongs dpe mdzod gtsug lag khang 'go dang par rgyal yum kri bgres tshan chogs chos sgron gyis bskul ma ji ltar gnang ba ltar du 'byug rgyal gsum pa mi dbang mnga' bdag rin po che 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug mchog gi bka' bzhin du spyi lo 1966lo khu rgyal yongs dpe mdzod btsugs gnang 'dug/rgyal yongs dpe mdzod kyi dgos pa ga ci yin zer ba cin phan bde 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di dam pa'i chos 'di yin da re snyigs ma'i dus lu dam pa'i chos kyi gzhi gsung rab kyi phyag dpe 'di tshu la thor nyams chags 'gyo ba 'i nyen la las skyob 'di srung spyob 'bad dgos gal can yin/ dam pa'i chos 'di chos srid gnyis cha lu rang dgos pa can cig yin chos dang 'jig rten gyi lnga ga ci rang yin rung slob spyong 'bad ba khu dpe cha 'di med thabs bral ba yin/ mas srid gnyis ga'i yon tan ga ra 106

dpe cha khu brten dgos nga bcas ra nang pa'i rgyal lab gcig yin pa wu brten mi ga ra'i re 'dun 'di gyi ma sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i don wu sgrub pa nyams len 'bad ni tshe 'di kyen ngan bar chad sel ni 'i don wu dpe cha med thabs med/ sprig zhan che chung med pa ga ra gis klog pa thos bsam dang sgong ba bsam gtan gnyis ka ra'i the tshom dang dogs pa sel ba'i don khu dpe cha 'di gal can yin/ rgyal lab nang yod pa'i dpe rnying sogs dpe cha'i rigs 'du gsog 'bad gtan bzhag 'bad 'di bzhag mi 'di kun khu phan pa'i don wu dpe mdzod 'di btsug sa gnang ba yin pas/rgyal yongs dpe mdzod 'di nang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'o rang gi zhal las gsungs pa'i sde snod gsum yongs su bsdus pa rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin poche tshang spar bskrun mi 'du ba gsum de cig bzhugs yod/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pa chen yo tshu gis mdzad pa'isku'i rgyal ba'i bka' ji lta ba bzhin du 'grel ba'i bstan bcos bstan 'gyur spar bskrun mi 'du ba dag pa gcig bzhugs yod/ 'od gyi chos lugs ris med kyi bla ma mkhas pa tshu gis mdzad gnang ba'i gsung 'thum rnam thar chos 'byung tshu dang bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la sogs pa blo'i mun pa sel ba'i sde snod gsum gyi phyag dpe'i rigs ga ra bzhugs yod pa yin/ chos lugs ris su ma chad pa'i phyag dpe sna tshogs da lta yod pa khu pod grangs nyis stong lhag pa cig yod pa las dpe tshan gyi cings kha sge rtsis ba cin dpe tshan grangs nyis 'grum lhag pa cig 'ong ni yin pas/rang thugs sa dge bka' rnying gi mdo sngags kyi bka' bstan chos skor tsam men pa ston khugs kyi bka' bstan yang bzhugs yod pa ma tshad pā li'i skad lu yod 107

pa'i gnas brtan sde pa'i thugs/ kyi sde snod gsum yang bzhugs yod/ de bzum sbre nang pa'i bla sprul mkhas pa dang gyi rgyal ba'i nang pa'i mkhas pa tshu gis bris gnang ba'i dpe deb yin skad lu yod pa dang bka' bstan 'ga' re gyi rgyal ba'i mkhas pa tshu gis skad thu bsgyur 'di yod mi'i rigs yin skad lu yod mi dpe deb kyi sde tshan yang zur du yod/dpe rnying thob dka' ba'i grangs 'di tshu ma phyi mi nyams pa bzhag ni'i don khu chung bzo'i 'phrul chas ( 5101011 11)thog wu spar btab 'bad dus nam gnas bar bzhag ni'i phan thabs stabs bde lag len yang yod pa ma tshad dpe cha so so'i mtshan 'di tshu las sla tog to 'bad mtshan byang / brdzod bya/ mdzad pa po gsum ka ra'i thog las 'tshol stabs bde ni gi dkar chag 'di tshu yang da lta bzo'i sgang yin/shing spar brko ni'i lugs srol spyi lo brgya phrag bcu bdun pa las rim pas dar te sod khu bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur gyi shing spar brko srol dar khyab byung nug rang re 'grag gi rgyal khab 'di nang shing spar brko ni zhabs drung rin po che 'i skabs las kun mkhyen bka' 'thum cha tshang ma brko rung nyer mkho'i rigs 'di tshu brko gnang nug de las rim pas sde srid mi 'gyur bstan pa dang rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyis shing spar brkos gnang nug de'i mthug las sde srid bco brgyad pa 'jigs med seng ge gis kun mkhyen bka' 'thum cha tshang dang sde srid nyer gcig pa 'grag rnam rgyal gyis sman gyi rgyud bzhi sgra ka tsan dbyangs gsum sogs brkos gnang ba'i dpe cha spar ma da lta'i skabs su bzhugs yod rung shing spar tshu me kyen khu brten bzhugs pa'i dus skabs ma byung 'dug yin rung mdo 108

mang rnam thar la sogs pa'i spar shing 'ga' re rab sde dang dgon sde lag sogs khu da lta'ang bzhugs yod rung la khu 'grub kyis nyams chags byung nug /da lta dpe mdzod nang shing spar rnying pa'i gras las rnam thar gyi spar shing dang kun mkhyen bka' 'thum gsar pa brkos yod pa ma tshad shing spar brko srol mi nyams ni'i don khu shing spar brko mi gnyis da lto kun mkhyen bka' 'thum zhus dag 'bad bzhin pa yin de bzum sbre shing par rnying pa 'di tshu yang ma tshang ba gsar brko 'bad ni dang yod pa nyams chags song ba tshu gsar btsugs 'bad 'di shing spar brko ni'i srol de mi nyams pa rgyun spyong 'bad ni'i don lu yin/ de bzhin du shing spar nyams chags mi 'gyo ni'i don khu da re rig gsar gyi 'phrul chas kyi sman rlang btab ni gi 'phrul chas yang yod/shing spar 'grub kyi nyes skyon srung ni'i don las sman btab ni 'di yang dpe mdzod nang yod mi spar shing kyang pa min pa rang re 'grag wu rab sde dgon sde lag sogs kyi nang yod mi shing spar tshu ga ra khu min btab ni gyi srogs ram dpe mdzod las 'bad tshugs pa'i re ba yod/dpe mdzod 'di bzum cig bzhings 'di 'di'i nang lu sangs rgyas gsung rab le sha cig bsdu bsog 'bad dgo mi 'di rang re rgyal lab nang gi grwa tshang dgon sde lha lang sogs gyi nang yod pa'i dpe cha rnying pa'i rigs deng skabs rlag ltor dang kha thor 'gyo ba'i nyen la che ba khu brten 'di tshu srung spyobs dang bdag 'dzin 'bad dgos pa dang de bzum sge dpe rnying gi ma dpe dpe mdzod nang du bzhugs pa las slar spar bskrun 'bad ni lu ma dpe'i dka' ngal mi 'ong ni dang ma 'ong 'byung 'gyur gyi rang 109

re'i rgyal khab nang gi na gzhon rig tsal can tshu gis chos dang lugs srol gang gi thad lu 'bad rung zhib 'chol dang slob spyong gnang mi lu phan thabs bde ba 'ong ni dang gzhan yang phyi phyogs las chos kyi skor las zhib 'tshol 'bad mi tshu lu yang bde thabs gsal btub pa ma tshad rang re mi dmangs khu yang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur 'thum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sgra tog gser gsum mdo mang gzhung rig gi dpe cha 'don cha rigs sku'i gzungs la sogs pa gang yang thob thabs bde tog to bzo ni gi don thu yin/mdor bsdu 'di gi 'bad zhu ba cin 'grag rgyal yongs dpe mdzod 'di nang rgyal ba'i gsung rabs ma thus pa dang lhag par rang rdzongs 'di nang yod pa'i gsung rabs 'di tshu nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel dang rang lugs kyi chos dang lugs srol zhib 'chol 'bad sa'i bsti gnas klog pa thos bsam dang sgong ba bsam gtan gyi lam gsal bar ston pa'i gzhung rig dpe cha'i 'byung khungs kyi lte ba bzum sbre skal pa nam gnas kyi bar lu dpe mdzod 'di las rtsa ba gsum wu zhabs tog 'chib tshugs pa'i re ba yin/sangs rgyas dbang phyugango tshab mdo chen rgyal yongs dpe mdzod/ 110

sgyu grag rin ko che 'byung krungs dang nus pa rnam par bshad pa mdor bsdus/nya gso rig sman gyi 'khrungs dpe rgyud chen shel gong 'phreng nas gsungs pa/ dang po rin po che'i nus pa la/ / mchog dang phal pa gnyis yin mtshog gyur pa/ / rgyal dang nyan rang byung sems rnal 'gyor gdung / / ring bsrel mchod 'chang bsnyen pas gdon srung zhing / / sgrib spyong nad sel skye ba sprin pa yi/ / lha las lhag pa'i dal 'gyor gtsang 'bras 'thob/ / ces gsungs pa ltar/ rin po che'i rgyal po rdo rje pha lam ni/ rdo rje 'di rin po che thams cad kyi rgyal po lta thu dbang btsan pa yin pas rin chen gzhan gang yang gcod pa dang brdar ba 'thugs pa sogs 'dis byed pas/ rdo rje yis ni rin chen pham/ / zhes so/ / sngon ri rab kyi 'ongs gseng du bden pa'i mthu brnyes pa'i spring srong zho 'thung zhes byu ba zhig yod pa de tshe 'thos pa'i rus babs pa'i lar yul chags pa la rdo rje'i gdan zhes grags pas rdo rje mthus mthar srid pa yongs su zhig pa'i dus kyang rgya gar rdo rje gdan mi 'jig cing / rdo rje'i mtshon cha dam bca' bzhi ldan du grags pa de lha gru'i rigs yul phal cher du phye ma 'thul ba las byung ba ste badz+ra nyi ra zhes rigs bzhi yod pa'i mchog ni badz+ra bha nyi ra zhes rdo rje chen po 'di shin tu dngas la dmar zhing smug pa zhig go rab badz+ra she la hi ra rdo rje chung ba zer ba la dog dmar shas che ba 'di gnyis yul dathus dang snyo phyogs snye ta snyi ra'i yul 'o na nas byung / 'bring ba ni badz+ra haṃ ran zhes dmar smug dngas la rin chen gzhan spri gcon thogs pa med pa ston nas 'byung ba yin/ dman pa ko rardzi zhes pa smug shas che ba mi dngas shing 7 111

yul yar khung dang khams phyogs ma nges pa nas 'byung ba'o/ 'a rin chen 'bar ba las/ gser dngul thu tig byu ru dang / / nor thu rin chen rin chen lnga/ / zhes 'byung ngo / / slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ / rin chen brtag pa'i bstan bcos gang / / rtogs pa mkhas pa rdo rje 'chang / / tshe yi nor thu 'chang ba rung / / yid bzhin sna tshogs nor thu 'chang / / yin spri nī li rin chen sogs/ / nor gya chen sa gzhan dag kyang / / 'chang bar byed pas 'chi ba kun/ / bzlog par 'gyur ba the tshom med/ / gang phyir nor thu'i mthu la ni/ / som nyi byed pa mi rigs te/ / nor ngu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ / mthu dang ldan par thams cad 'dod/ / ces gsungs pa/rin chen g.yu ni be+e rā rdo'i rgyal po la 'jug 'di la rigs bzhi ste bsam gyi dang ma lū ram gi ka gha gi lha gi'o/ dang pa mdog sngo la dkar shas che la 'od zer bcas pa'o/gnyis pa rma bya'i snyo la rdul gyis cung zad yog pa 'du'o gsum pa sngo nag gi mdog can no/bzhi pa mdog sngo nag ser kha bcas pa'o/ de ni rgya gar lugs kyi ngos 'dzin khugs yin la/ sod kyi ngos 'dzin lugs ni g.yu rnying gsum bar g.yu gnyis g.yu sar 3dang brgyad du dbye ba yin/ g.yu rnying 3ni sngo zhing dkar la bkrag mdangs che la mun par yang mthong la de la drug dkar dang sngo zhing dmar mdangs che la snum pa drug dmar re gnyis zil gyis gnon pa grag dkar las cung sngo ba la drug spyang zer ba'o/ bar g.yu gnyisani drug dkar 'du la de las bkrag cung zhing 'o la can g.yu sngon drug dmar cung g.yar la mdangs zhan pa bar dmar zhes pa'o/ g.yu gsar gsum ni rigs dbyibs ma nges pa gsar nyams can ni rgya g.yu ste g.yu bzhu yang zer/ shin tu gsar pa rdo sra mkhregs dkar gong 'du ba 'gram ma can g.yu ro dang la dog zhan pa ser la dbyibs gsar rnying ma nges 112

pa la drug se zhes ngan pa'o/ sod gangs can du 'bab pa'i chu 'grubs pas kyen byas nas gangs can du 'thor thu 'byung ba dang 'ga' zhig rgya nag dang zhang zhung nas 'byung ba'o/3 byu ru'i ming la tsan da ka pra ba la bi gra ma muṅka ba ni 'di la rigs gsum ste dmar mo dang nag yo dang dkar po dmar mo ni mchog nag po ni hor pas gtsigs cher byas pa yin dkar po ni sod la gtsigs che yang rgya gar bas gtsigs chung bas len pa ma brtson stabs dkon par bshad/ 'di dag ni mtha'i rgya mtsho 'gram gyi brag dang bye ma las shing ltar skye bas rgyu dngos rdo yin kyang skye thugasas shing yang zer te/ dmar po ni sing ga la dang mu ku ṭa la sogs pa'i gling nas 'byung de yang dmar kyi rnying pa dang dmar smug la gsar pa byed pa dang dmar po skam po brag las skye ba dmar kyi rlang gsher che ba'i bye ma las skyes pa'o/ rting pa sa mtshams lu thug pa dkar shas che ba yin/nag yo ni nub phyogs kyi yul gling so ki dha ri bya ba nas 'byung / da lta tshong pa rnams dmar yo ched gnyer nas bsgrubs pa'o /4 rje rang 'byung rdo rjes/ rgyal ba'i ring bsrel nor bu'i mchog / dgos 'dod thams 'byung bar byed/ / nyan thos rang rgyal byung chub sems/ / de bzhin dal 'gyor ldan pa'i gdung / / mchod cing lus la bcangs pa yis/ / gdon kun phyogs su nye mi nus / /zhes gsungs so/ rin chen mu men ni ming gi rnam grangs bai ra ṭa rā dza warta rā dza gshe bi rā ṭa dza 'di la rigs gsum ste gser thig 'dres pa gser mu men sngo nag slad med shin hu gsal ba mthing mu men/ sngo spya rdo dkar 'dres pa g.yu mu men/ snga ma nas gyi ma rim pas zhan/ 'di la che gang mang yul mtshams nan ta pra sa ta byu ba'i ri dang skam nas 'byung ba dang / rā dzo gi ri nas kyang 'byung ba las rgya mcho las mi 'byung ngo /113

5 rin chen mu tig la rigs chen drug ni/ rak+ta yuk+ta ka zhes mu tig dmar yo mchog hu bshad/ ga dza muk+ta ka zhes dkar mdangs che ba glang po che mtshog gi spyi bo'i mchi ba'i nang nas 'byung ba ste 'di yod pa'i glang yo che de'i dri tshor ba tsam nas glang yo che phal pa rnams 'gros par byed pa'i zhig las 'byung / ba wu muk+ta ka ni sngo mdangs can sran ma che shos tsam pa rgya gar snyo gyogs nags khrod du shing du zhes pa'i 'dab mar chang babs pa las 'byung ba rin thang che/ ram pa multe ka zhes cung zad ljang nyams can che chung sran ma tsam pa rgya gar shur phyogs gyi gling phran dza ba ni ba byu ba zhig gi shing ke la zhes pa'i 'dab ma la char babs pa las 'byung ba/ sarba mu ka zhes se 'gru dmar po rlon pa'i mdog 'du ba tshad kyang de tsam zhig nub phyogs hor yul gyi sgrul 'ga' zhig gi klad pa las 'byung ba/ shi sa ka mu ka zhes cung zad ser nyams yod pa che chung ma nges pa/yul siṅga la'i rgya mtshor gnas pa'i srog chags nya gyis las 'byung ba drug go / /6 kun mkhyen lhu ḍa ri gas/ zi khyim sin du'i chu klung dag gi 'gram/ / gser dmar yin par grags/ 'di la klu yi rin chen sna bdun po/ / ma lus 'dus pa'i yid bzhin nor thu 'du/ / lto tsho1ga che ra dmar zhib brtags 'ja' 'od snang / / dug chus reg na dbang yo'i gzhu nyid stono/ / ces gsungs/ gser la ming gi rnam grangs mang du yod kyang rigs chen gnyis dang rigs thun grag sogs 'byung bas/ rigs chen ni dmar yo dang ser po gnyis dman yo ni ling dzagro braka'i 'bras thu rgya mtshor lhung ba rmis zos pa'i gran thams cad gser du gyur pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyis bye ma dang 'dres par chu 'gram du chags pas dzaḥ chu so'i gser zhes grags la/ gnyis pa ser po la mtshog dman gnyis lasamachog ni sa le sbram zhes pa'am dza'i chu bo'i gser snga ma dang rgyu mtshan dang 'du ba/ la 114
